Your company operates a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are assigned to configure an agreement that grants clients a specified per-unit discount when they purchase a certain quantity of a particular item.  
  
The parameters are as follows:  
  
- 51 to 100 `"` 10 %/unit  
- 101 and more `"` 15 %/unit  
  
You configure a trade agreement.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
A Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management line-discount trade agreement can apply different discount percentages to a specific item according to ordered-quantity ranges. Quantity breaks of 51–100 at 10% and 101 or more at 15% therefore apply the required discount percentage to each unit on the qualifying order line.

**Learn more:** [Look up applicable prices and discounts — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/look-up-applicable-prices-discounts) · [Create a new trade agreement — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/create-new-trade-agreement)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
An employee identifies an inventory discrepancy.  
  
You need to create an inventory-blocking transaction.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish the goal? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A quality order blocks the quantity entered for the item, and manual inventory blocking creates a blocking transaction directly on the Inventory blocking page. These are direct mechanisms for creating the required inventory-blocking transaction.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-blocking)

questions.question:
You need to give the costing manager the required information.  
  
What should you do first?
questions.explanation:
The **Check open quantities** report identifies issue transactions that cannot be settled against financially updated inventory receipts as of the selected closing date. It provides the information needed to identify items that will not be fully settled before inventory close.\
\
**Learn more:** [Physically received purchase orders don't appear on the inventory closing report - Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/supply-chain/costing/check-open-quantities-not-show-physically-received-purchase-orders) · [Inventory close - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-close)

questions.question:
You need to configure the manufacturer and year for the desks.  
  
What should you configure first?
questions.explanation:
An attribute type establishes the data type and, when applicable, the list of permitted values that an attribute can use. Manufacturer and year attributes therefore require their attribute types to be set up before the attributes can be defined and applied to the desk product data.\
\
**Learn more:** [Engineering attributes and engineering attribute search](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/engineering-change-management/engineering-attributes-and-search)

questions.question:
You must configure the system to identify complaints for the chalk and blackboard items.  
  
Which two settings should you configure? Each answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Item sampling defines the percentage or quantity to inspect and can use **Full blocking** to block the entire lot or order-line quantity when testing fails. Quality orders schedule and record the required quality tests for the received items.\
\
**Learn more:** [Quality management item sampling - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-item-sampling) · [Quality associations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations)

questions.question:
You must configure the system to identify complaints for the chalk and blackboard items.  
  
Which two settings should you configure? Each answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A quantity commitment records the quantity of whiteboard paint that a school agrees to purchase over the agreement period. Enabling **Max is enforced** prevents the combined sales-order quantities linked to that commitment from exceeding the agreed quantity, preserving inventory for other schools.

**Learn more:** [Enter sales agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/enter-sales-agreements) · [Sales agreements overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-agreements)

questions.question:
You must process the expedited replacement of the photocopier.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Release the order to the warehouse for shipping.
Create and release a load for the order.
Send the shipment to the warehouse before sending it to the customer.

questions.explanation:
An advance exchange order enables a replacement item to be delivered to the customer before the defective item is returned. This supports an expedited photocopier replacement while preserving the return-and-replacement process.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create an item replacement order - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/create-item-replacement-order)

questions.question:
You need to set up the smartboards.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: a new product master for each variation
variants by using the variant suggestions tool

questions.explanation:
A single smartboard product master can use the Size dimension to define 55-inch, 75-inch, and 85-inch variants, allowing variant-specific costs while minimizing distinct product definitions. The Variant suggestions tool generates the selected dimension combinations as variants for that product master.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create predefined product variants - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/create-predefined-product-variants) · [Product dimensions - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-dimensions)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A distribution company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company introduces a new safety policy that requires all business units to undergo a rapid routine safety checkup every week.  
  
To comply with the new policy, the warehouse manager must ensure the following:  
  
- The business unit is unavailable for use during that time.  
- Maintenance activities are performed during the lunch break to prevent production downtime losses.  
  
You must configure the system to satisfy the safety requirements.  
  
Which two configurations should you complete? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Work order service levels define the expected start and end dates and times for work orders, enabling maintenance to be scheduled within the lunch-break window. Work order types can make maintenance downtime-related information mandatory, ensuring the maintenance activity records the period in which the business unit is unavailable.

**Learn more:** [Service level and description - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-work-orders/service-level-and-description) · [Work order types - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-work-orders/work-order-types)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the logistics manager for a distribution company.  
  
Your primary carrier service supplies transportation rates between New York City and Colorado. These are flat rates based on the pickup city or general area, as follows:  
  
- New York City = $500  
- Colorado = $450  
  
You need to configure Transportation Management to calculate the rate from New York City to Colorado.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a Point-to-Point based Rate Master with the rates broken out by pieces.
Using the Point-to-Point engine with an empty break master, assign rates based on starting and ending locations.
Set up zones in the Zone Master for New York City and Colorado. Assign rates to each zone in the Zone Master by starting and ending location.
Use a mileage-based rate engine to configure a rate master that calculates the rate based on the miles from New York City to Colorado.

questions.explanation:
A Point-to-Point rate engine can apply a flat carrier rate using origin and destination location fields. With no break structure, the rate is selected by the starting and ending locations rather than calculated from shipment pieces or mileage. Rate-base assignments support different carrier price points by destination and service.

**Learn more:** [Set up rate masters, rate bases, and break masters](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/tasks/set-up-rate-masters) · [Transportation management engines](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/transportation-management-engines)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the warehouse manager for a large distribution company and are responsible for all outbound processing. You decide to implement cluster-picking functionality to improve picking efficiency.  
  
When warehouse workers sign in to the mobile device to process a cluster pick, work items are not assigned to positions as expected.  
  
You need to validate the cluster-picking configuration.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Review the Sales order Work template.
Validate the Cluster profile's positions and sorting setup.
Validate whether there is a Cluster profile selected on the Mobile device menu item.
Review the Location directive for sales picking.

questions.explanation:
Cluster profiles control the number of cluster positions and the sequencing and verification of picking work. The mobile device menu item used for cluster picking must be configured with the applicable Cluster profile ID. Those settings determine whether and how cluster work is assigned to positions.

**Learn more:** [Set up cluster picking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/set-up-cluster-picking) · [Cluster position full - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cluster-position-full)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to manage its procurement operations.  
  
A purchasing manager creates a procurement request for the main product line from an offshore vendor. The vendor tells the purchasing manager that, because of raw-material shortages, the items will be delivered in two phases. The purchasing manager wants to preserve this information while keeping the procurement request intact for tracking.  
  
You need to configure the procurement requirements before the goods are shipped.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A purchase order delivery schedule can divide an ordered quantity into multiple vendor shipments and delivery dates while retaining the original commercial line. Landed Cost voyages can also track inbound purchase-order lines and their container assignments, including delivery-related information. A vessel is merely an attribute of a voyage, while a folio is a subset of a container used primarily for customs and cost handling.

**Learn more:** [Create purchase orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-order-creation) · [Manage voyages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/manage-voyages)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to lessen the fulfillment team’s workload.  
  
Which form should you use?
questions.explanation:
To reduce manual data entry for the fulfillment/order-processing team you configure Default order settings on the released product. These define the default site, warehouse, and the minimum, maximum, standard and multiple quantities plus lead times that populate automatically on order lines, so processors do not have to key them in each time. That directly lessens the team's workload. The other forms (item model group, sales/marketing or product information management parameters) control costing, dimensions, or global parameters rather than defaulting order quantities per product.

**Learn more:** [Default order settings (Microsoft Learn)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/default-order-settings) · [Default order settings guide](https://dynamics-tips.com/default-order-settings/)

options.text: Reject the nonconformance and add the items to the quality order.
Reject the nonconformance and add a related operation.
Approve the nonconformance and add the items to the quality order.
Approve the nonconformance and add a related operation.

questions.explanation:
For an approved nonconformance, a related operation records the corrective work and can include the items consumed to perform that work. A quality order is intended for quality testing or retesting rather than recording correction items.

**Learn more:** [Operations for nonconformances - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-operations) · [Quality and nonconformance management overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-management-processes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has run out of inventory in warehouse 22 but has excess stock in warehouse 11. The warehouses are associated with the same site.  
  
The inventory must be transferred from warehouse 11 to warehouse 22. The company must financially retain ownership of the inventory and be able to report where the inventory value resides at all times.  
  
You need to create an order to move the inventory. What should you do?

options.text: Create a transfer order from the transit warehouse to warehouse 22.
Create a transfer order from warehouse 11 to the transit warehouse.
Create a transfer order from warehouse 11 to warehouse 22.
Create a sales order for warehouse 11 and a purchase order for warehouse 22.

questions.explanation:
A transfer order moves inventory internally from a specified shipping warehouse to a specified receiving warehouse while retaining ownership within the company. It records the movement and supports warehouse-level inventory visibility and reporting. For this movement, warehouse 11 is the source and warehouse 22 is the destination.

**Learn more:** [Set up warehouses for transfer orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/transfer-orders-warehouse) · [Integrate Supply Chain Management transfer orders with Intelligent Order Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/intelligent-order-management/integrate-transfer-orders)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company has WarehouseA and WarehouseB. Both warehouses pick, pack, and ship inventory. Forklifts operate throughout the day. The technicians who service the forklifts are based at WarehouseA.  
  
A forklift at WarehouseB shuts down intermittently. WarehouseB needs a temporary forklift while repairs to the forklift are completed.  
  
You need to configure the system for the repair and the temporary forklift.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A maintenance request records the forklift repair requirement and supports an associated work order. It also provides the **Send loan asset** action to register a temporary replacement forklift as a loan asset, with its expected return date and lifecycle state tracking. [Maintenance requests](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/manage-maintenance-requests/maintenance-request-overview)

**Learn more:** [Maintenance requests — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/manage-maintenance-requests/maintenance-request-overview) · [Asset loans — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/manage-maintenance-requests/asset-loan)

You are the customer relations manager at a wholesale company. You perform promotion planning and must monitor fund usage.  
  
You need to configure a trade allowance agreement to register and track promotion contracts.  
  
Which two items must you set up before creating the agreement? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Trade allowance agreements allocate approved promotional funds to promotion contracts. They also use predefined customer hierarchies to select the customer groups or individual customer accounts targeted by the agreement. Consequently, trade allowance funds and a customer category hierarchy must be configured before an agreement can be created.

**Learn more:** [Trade allowance management - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/trade-allowance)

A company creates multiple item costing versions.  
  
All new and existing items have associated costs. After the costs are defined, the company realizes that the activation date has not been updated.  
  
You need to update the items for activation using the current date.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set the item cost record status to Active
Set the form date to today and leave the item cost record status at Pending
Set the item cost record status to Pending
Set the cost price and date of price on the released product

questions.explanation:
Item cost records remain in Pending status until they are activated. When activation occurs, the record becomes Active and its effective date is updated to the actual activation date; setting the form date to today ensures that activation uses the current date.

**Learn more:** [Costing versions overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/costing-versions) · [There is no From date value on the Active prices tab of the Item price page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/supply-chain/costing/no-from-date-active-prices-tab-item-price)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management in a single legal entity that has one site containing Warehouse1 and Warehouse2. A customer regularly orders an item that the company normally keeps in stock in Warehouse1.  
  
Because of shipping-cost agreements, the customer requires orders to be shipped from Warehouse2.  
  
You need to configure the system to satisfy this requirement.  
  
Which configuration should you configure?

options.text: Set the item default order settings to Warehouse1 only.
Set the customer default to Warehouse1 and set the item default order settings to Warehouse2.
Set the customer default to Warehouse2 and the item default order settings to Warehouse1.
Set the customer default to Warehouse1 and set the item default order settings to Warehouse1.
Set the customer default to Warehouse2 only.

questions.explanation:
Customer defaults support a customer-specific warehouse exception, while default order settings define the normal site and warehouse from which an item is sourced or stored and are applied when sales orders are created. Keeping Warehouse1 as the item's default order setting preserves the standard stocking source, and setting Warehouse2 as the customer's default directs that customer's orders to the required shipping warehouse.

**Learn more:** [Default order settings for dimensions and product variants - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/default-order-settings)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A retail distributor is implementing Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Wholesale customers receive a 10 percent discount from list price for the current calendar year. CustomerA is a wholesaler that has agreed to a pilot program for a new product, with terms to receive a discounted fixed price for 100 each of the product during the next six months. The distributor will charge penalties to Customer if the 100 each are not sold within that period.  
  
You must configure pricing for Customer.  
  
Which three configurations should you set up? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a sales agreement with the price and discount is fixed parameter set to yes.
Create a trade agreement for wholesalers.
Set the find next parameter on trade agreements.
Create a sales agreement with the max enforced parameter set to yes.
Set the effective date on the trade agreement to begin after the sales agreement.

questions.explanation:
A sales trade agreement supplies the annual 10 percent wholesaler discount. A sales agreement supports CustomerA’s time-bounded quantity commitment and its special pricing; sales-agreement prices and discounts override applicable trade agreements. Fixing price and discount requires order lines to retain the agreement’s price and discount in order to remain linked to, and fulfill, the commitment. Enforcing the maximum limits use of the agreement’s special terms to the committed quantity of 100.

**Learn more:** [Sales agreements overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-agreements) · [Enter sales agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/enter-sales-agreements)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to manage work orders in Asset Management.  
  
Some work orders require workers with current certifications. Active certifications are maintained in Supply Chain Management.  
  
You need to configure the certification requirement for the work order.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance job types define the work performed by work-order jobs and provide a Required certificates FastTab where certificate requirements are added. Those requirements enable assignment and scheduling of workers with the required current certifications.

**Learn more:** [Maintenance job types, categories, variants, trades, and checklists - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-work-orders/job-groups-and-job-types-variants-trades-and-checklists) · [Schedule work orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/work-order-scheduling/schedule-work-orders)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company produces street, mountain, and racing bicycles.  
  
The company wants to use product variants to manage bicycle configuration.  
  
You need to configure the bicycles in the system.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create mountain, street, and racing bicycles as separate configuration models.
Use one item number for all types of bicycles. Use a separate configuration number for each type of bicycle.
Use different item numbers for mountain, street, and racing bicycles.

questions.explanation:
A product master can generate multiple product variants by using product dimensions, including the Configuration dimension. The bicycle types can therefore share one item number while each type is identified by its own configuration number.

**Learn more:** [Product information overview – Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-information) · [Dimension-based product configuration overview – Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/dimension-based-product-configuration)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
An item's sales double during the holiday season, and you plan to revise its minimum coverage proposal.  
  
You need to update the item's new minimum quantity in the safety stock journal lines.  
  
Which two actions can achieve this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Update the Multiplication factor field. Calculate the minimum proposal for the inventory level.
Update the New minimum quantity value to match the value in the Calculated minimum quantity field.
Select the Service level. Calculate the minimum proposal for the inventory level.
Select the Use the calculated minimum quantity as the new minimum quantity parameter option. Calculate the minimum proposal for the inventory level.

questions.explanation:
A safety stock journal supports manually entering a New minimum quantity that matches the Calculated minimum quantity. It also provides an option to automatically copy the calculated minimum quantities to the New minimum quantity column after calculation. Multiplication factor and service level settings affect the proposed calculation but do not themselves update the new-minimum values. [Use the safety stock journal to update minimum coverage for items](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-journal)

**Learn more:** [Use the safety stock journal to update minimum coverage for items](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-journal)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You must adjust inventory and also override the existing item posting configuration.  
  
You use the inventory adjustment journal.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation:
An inventory adjustment journal updates inventory gains or losses while retaining the default general ledger offset account from the item group posting profile. To override the default posting accounts, use an inventory movement journal and specify a general ledger offset account.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory journals - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journals)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must configure brake testing to satisfy the operational requirements.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer forms part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set execution to after product receipt.
Set per updated quantity to yes.
Set execution to before product receipt.
Set per updated quantity to no.

questions.explanation:
For purchasing quality associations, setting execution to **After** product receipt creates the quality order after the receipt event, when the material is available for testing. Setting **Per updated quantity** to **Yes** generates quality orders based on each newly received quantity, so each receipt is covered by the configured testing process.

**Learn more:** [Quality associations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations) · [Quality orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-orders)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company plans to implement shipping manifests in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company wants to use a multiple-level manifest process.  
  
You need to ensure that the system is configured for multiple-level manifest processing.  
  
What should you validate?

options.text: All container groups are manifested before the shipment is manifested
All containers are of the status open before the group is manifested
The allow split picks configuration is enabled
All container types are set up with all four attributes

questions.explanation:
A multi-level manifest process requires workers to manifest every container before its related container group, and to manifest every container group before its related shipment. This enforced hierarchy ensures that all container groups are manifested before the shipment is manifested.

**Learn more:** [Pack containers for shipment - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/packing-containers)

questions.question:
A company uses trade agreements for its customers. Prices for certain customers must be rounded to the nearest US dollar.  
  
A customer states that prices are not being rounded to the nearest US dollar as required.  
  
You need to fix the issue.  
  
In **Trade agreement journals**, which option should you use?
questions.explanation:
Smart rounding must be applied to the trade-agreement journal lines so their prices are recalculated according to the configured rounding rule, such as rounding to the nearest US dollar. **Apply smart rounding** performs that update; viewing smart rounding only displays the result.\
\
**Learn more:** [Trade agreement currency conversion issues](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/supply-chain/sales/trade-agreement-currencies)

questions.question:
A company uses trade agreements for its customers. Prices for certain customers must be rounded to the nearest US dollar.  
  
A customer states that prices are not being rounded to the nearest US dollar as required.  
  
You need to fix the issue.  
  
In **Trade agreement journals**, which option should you use?

options.text: Run the Update expiry date job.
Configure an item model group reservation policy.

questions.explanation:
The item model group reservation policy supports **FIFO date-controlled** reservation, which reserves batches by the earliest item receipt date under the first-in, first-out principle. Reserving the batch in this order aligns the inventory issued on the sale with the FIFO cost layer, so the cost of goods sold and resulting sales margin reflect the applicable inventory cost.

**Learn more:** [Reserve inventory quantities - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/reserve-inventory-quantities) · [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq)

questions.question:
Solution: Use the **Find sales order** function to link the return order with the original sales order.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation: The **Find sales order** function links the return order to its originating sales order line, allowing the return to use the original sales order’s quantity and price.

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Solution: Create a margin alert.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Margin alerts are used to monitor margins, not to populate return-order data from an original sales order. A return order must be created in relation to the original sales line for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to copy the original unit price; therefore, creating a margin alert does not ensure the original quantity and price are used.\
\
**Learn more:** [Sales returns - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-returns) · [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a sales order that uses the **Returned order** sales type.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Returned order is the appropriate sales-order type for customer returns, but it does not by itself copy the original sales line's quantity and price. Using **Find sales order** to select the invoiced sales line establishes the return-line reference and retrieves details including quantity and price from that original line.\
\
**Learn more:** [Sales returns - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/ja-jp/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-returns) · [Sales and marketing overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-ie/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/overview-sales-marketing)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
You need to satisfy the requirements for CustomerD.  
  
Which two parameters should be configured? Each answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Sellable days specifies the minimum number of days that a customer must have to sell an item before its batch expires, so it can enforce CustomerD’s 30-day remaining-life requirement for vinegar. The relevant item must be FEFO date-controlled for sellable days functionality to work.\
\
**Learn more:** [Master planning for products with limited shelf life - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/shelf-life)

questions.question:
You need to identify the number of pickle bottles in each case.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Unit of measure conversion per product variant
Unit of measure conversation per product

questions.explanation:
A unit-of-measure conversion per product variant supports different case-to-bottle conversion factors for variants of one consolidated product. This accommodates the differing quantities per case for the 8 oz and 16 oz pickle bottle sizes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Unit of measure conversion per product variant - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/uom-conversion-per-product-variant)

questions.question:
You must make changes in response to the internal audit findings.  
  
Which feature should be enabled?
questions.explanation:
Inventory journal workflows require approval before inventory adjustment journals, including write-offs, can be posted. They provide documented approval control and workflow history, addressing unsupported damage write-offs and the absence of management authorization. [Microsoft Learn: Inventory journal approval workflows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journal-workflow)\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory journal approval workflows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journal-workflow)

questions.question:
You need to address the mango preserves issue while minimizing the number of location directives.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Warehouse management product filters categorize warehouse items by handling characteristics such as refrigeration requirements. A location-directive query can use the resulting filter group to send mango preserves to refrigerated locations while retaining a small, reusable set of directives instead of creating directives for individual products.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure product filters for warehouse transactions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/filters-and-filter-codes)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company produces and sells surround-sound audio systems. A third-party company produces the stereo receivers as part of the bill of materials (BOM) for complete sound systems.  
  
You need to automatically generate a purchase order for the stereo receiver from the production order for a sound system.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign the Vendor account to the service item BOM line.
Set service item BOM line type to Vendor.
Set the service item BOM line type to Pegged supply.
Link the service items to the vendor on the costing sheet.
Attach the service item to the parent item as a BOM line.

questions.explanation:
For subcontracted production, the outsourced work must be represented by an inventory-tracked service item attached to the parent item as a BOM line. Setting that BOM line to the Vendor type causes a subcontractor purchase order to be created automatically when the production order is estimated. The vendor account on the BOM line identifies the subcontractor to receive the purchase order.

**Learn more:** [Bills of materials and formulas - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/bill-of-material-bom)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
You need to finalize the shipments.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Confirm the load and generate packing slips and bills of lading.
Confirm shipments, generate shipping documents, and send an ASN.
Confirm shipments and generate pick/put work.
Confirm the load, generate picking lists, and send an ASN.

questions.explanation:
Completing outbound shipments requires shipment confirmation, generation of the shipping documents, and transmission of an ASN containing the shipment details. Picking and putaway activities precede shipment completion, and confirming only the load does not complete the full outbound-shipment process.\
\
**Learn more:** [You can't confirm a shipment because of incomplete or missing work](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/supply-chain/warehousing/shipment-for-load-could-not-confirmed-all-work-must-complete)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
You need to finalize the shipments.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create purchase orders from sales orders.

questions.explanation:
The requirement is to capture additional/indirect costs in the item cost, and each listed answer is meant to be a complete solution on its own. Setting up a costing sheet (E) lets you add indirect cost surcharges/rates (overhead) into the calculated cost, and setting up commodity pricing (C) lets item cost reflect fluctuating commodity/market prices. FIFO with marking (A) and creating purchase orders from sales orders (B) address actual-cost matching for specific orders rather than the costing configuration asked for, and creating a costing version (D) alone is a container for standard costs, not a standalone way to satisfy the stated costing requirement in this scenario.

**Learn more:** [Costing sheet setup and calculations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq) · [Costing versions for planned costs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/simulate-cost-changes-costing-version-planned-costs)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for inventory management.  
  
You need to adjust inventory while overriding the existing item posting setup.  
  
Which journal type should you use?
questions.explanation:
An inventory movement journal lets users manually specify a general ledger offset account, allowing the default posting accounts to be overridden. An inventory adjustment journal instead posts the extra cost using the item group posting profile's configured account.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory journals - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/he-il/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journals) · [Initialize stock levels in the warehouse - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/initialize-stock-levels-warehouse)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses the warehouse mobile app for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You must create a menu item to reprint license plate labels. Reprinting a license plate label must not generate warehouse work.  
  
You need to configure the warehouse mobile app to add the new menu item.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set the Activity code to Cancel work
Set the Activity code to None

questions.explanation:
Warehouse Management mobile-app flows that are not directly related to warehouse work are configured with the mobile-device menu item Mode set to **Indirect**. Reprinting an existing license plate label is a non-work operation, so it requires Indirect mode.

**Learn more:** [Set up a mobile device menu item for completing mixed license plates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/mobile-device-complete-mixed-lp-menu) · [Query item data on a mobile device](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/warehouse-app-item-inquiry)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A distribution company wants to configure barcodes in its Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system for warehouse scanning.  
  
Barcodes will be entered manually. You need to reduce the risk of barcode-entry errors.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new barcode, enter the value, select the type, and enter the mask.
Select an item, select the barcode type, select max length, and enter the value.
Select an item and set up security on the barcode field.
Create a new barcode, enter the value, select the type, and enter the size and max length.

questions.explanation:
A barcode definition should include the barcode type, size, and maximum length. The size and maximum-length settings constrain the expected barcode format and input length, helping prevent manual-entry errors. Microsoft’s barcode-type setup procedure includes creating the barcode definition, selecting the barcode type, and entering both Size and Maximum length.

**Learn more:** [Maintain bar code types - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/maintain-barcode-types)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
You need to turn on automatic firming of planned orders from the master planning solution.  
  
Where do you enable this functionality?
questions.explanation:
Automatic firming for Planning Optimization is enabled as a feature in the Feature management workspace. Firming time fences can subsequently be configured in coverage, item, or master-plan setup; Master planning parameters supply related processing defaults rather than enable the capability itself.\
\
**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
A warehouse picks and ships products.  
  
The warehouse completes work immediately when it is automatically released to the warehouse.  
  
You need to configure waves to enable automatic work creation.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Automate wave creation and automatically process work.
Automate wave creation and process the wave at release to warehouse.
Select the wave template and attribute to automatically process.
Automate replenishment and process the wave at release.

questions.explanation:
In a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management wave template, setting **Automate wave creation** to Yes creates a wave when an order is released to the warehouse. Setting **Process wave at release to warehouse** to Yes automatically processes that wave and creates the work when the line is released.\
\
**Learn more:** [Wave templates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-templates)

questions.question:
A warehouse picks and ships products.  
  
The warehouse completes work immediately when it is automatically released to the warehouse.  
  
You need to configure waves to enable automatic work creation.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Safety margins configured on a master plan can simulate longer lead times or uncertainty for that specific plan across its planning calculations without affecting the plan used for daily planning. This meets the requirement for broad supply-chain delay simulation while preserving daily item planning.

**Learn more:** [Safety margins - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/safety-margins)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An e-commerce retail company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company frequently encounters situations where extra freight charges arise from weight variances and fuel surcharges, but it does not always want to review small deviations from anticipated charges. The company wants to use the system's freight-charge reconciliation capabilities.  
  
You need to configure the system to support these freight-charge discrepancies.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
The Freight bill audit master defines the minimum and maximum tolerance levels for automatic freight reconciliation and specifies how overpayment and underpayment discrepancies within those limits are handled. It therefore allows small differences between expected freight-bill amounts and actual carrier-invoice charges, such as weight discrepancies and fuel surcharges, to be reconciled without manual review.

**Learn more:** [Reconcile freight in transportation management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/reconcile-freight-transportation-management)

questions.question:
Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You must adjust inventory and override the current item-posting configuration.  
  
You use the movement journal.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation:
An inventory movement journal adjusts inventory quantities and can override the default item posting accounts by using a specified general ledger offset account. It therefore supports both the inventory amendment and the posting-configuration override.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory journals - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journals) · [Initialize stock levels in the warehouse - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/initialize-stock-levels-warehouse)

questions.question:
Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You must adjust inventory and override the current item-posting configuration.  
  
You use the movement journal.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation:
Asset counter types can be configured with a unit such as liters and used by counter-based maintenance-plan lines to create preventive maintenance scheduling from asset usage. Asset service levels are transferred to maintenance requests and work orders and are used in work-order scheduling; their expected start and end periods accommodate the increased servicing time.

**Learn more:** [Counters - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-objects/counters) · [Maintenance plans - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-plans)

A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and frequently uses consigned inventory.  
  
The company wants to reduce inventory-entry time.  
  
You must set up the default settings for consignment replenishment lines.  
  
Which three options can you configure? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
For consignment replenishment order lines, the applicable Purchase order default-order settings are Default site, Default warehouse, and the Stopped check box. Quantity settings such as Multiple and Standard order quantity are not applied to consignment replenishment lines.

**Learn more:** [Default order settings for dimensions and product variants - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/default-order-settings)

A company is implementing sales order functionality in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company has a business requirement to fulfill sales orders by using direct delivery.  
  
You need to enter a direct-delivery sales order so that a purchase order is created automatically.  
  
What should you do after entering the sales order and its lines?

options.text: Change the order type to journal and manually enter a PO for the sales order line items on the sales order header.
Change the delivery type on the sales order line to direct delivery and select save.
Select automatic and confirm the sales order on the line level setup tab in the reservation field.
Change the customer's address to the vendor's direct delivery address and confirm the sales order.

questions.explanation:
A direct-delivery sales line must be marked with the Direct delivery delivery type. Saving the line initiates the direct-delivery process, which creates the linked purchase order for vendor shipment to the customer. Microsoft’s direct-delivery workflow identifies the sales line as direct delivery and creates the associated purchase order.

**Learn more:** [Direct deliveries - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/direct-deliveries) · [Ship orders as direct deliveries - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/ship-orders-direct-deliveries)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must configure financial components for the new items.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign items to a FIFO item model group.
Assign the raw materials to a standard cost item model group. Assign finished goods to a FIFO item model group.
Create item model groups for raw materials and finished goods by using different ledger accounts. Assign items to these groups.
Assign raw materials to a standard cost item group. Assign finished goods to a FIFO item group.
Create item groups for raw materials and finished goods by using different ledger accounts. Assign items to these groups.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, inventory valuation methods such as Standard cost and FIFO are assigned through item model groups. Item groups contain the ledger accounts that apply to items, so separate raw-material and finished-goods item groups support different ledger-account postings. [Cost management home page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/cost-management-home-page) and [Prepare to maintain standard costs for manufactured items](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/prepare-maintain-standard-costs-manufactured-items) describe these respective roles.

**Learn more:** [Cost management home page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/cost-management-home-page) · [Prepare to maintain standard costs for manufactured items](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/prepare-maintain-standard-costs-manufactured-items)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company creates new bills of materials (BOMs). The company subcontracts with a vendor to manufacture one component of a BOM.  
  
You need to ensure that only the production manager can approve BOMs.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign security permissions to approve the BOM version but not the related BOM.
Assign security permissions to the user for the approval form.
Assign security permissions to the Vendor portal.
Set up the approver as a vendor.
Set up the approver as an employee.

questions.explanation:
BOM approval is controlled by security access to the approval form, so that permission should be granted only to the production manager. The approver must be set up as an employee. A BOM version can be approved only if the related BOM is approved; therefore, permission limited to the version but excluding the BOM does not meet the requirement.

**Learn more:** [Bills of materials and formulas – Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/bill-of-material-bom)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A corporation has two subsidiary businesses established as separate legal entities. One business will purchase a new item from the other and has negotiated a discount for the first six months of the arrangement.  
  
You must ensure that the system applies the discount for the specified period.  
  
Which of the following agreement types should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Trade agreements define negotiated item prices and discounts for customer or vendor transactions and can be restricted to a specified validity-date range. A trade agreement can therefore apply the negotiated discount during the first six months and cease applying it after its end date.

**Learn more:** [Procurement and sourcing overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/procurement-sourcing-overview) · [Price simulation - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/price-simulation)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Products are being added to purchase orders for the wrong vendors.  
  
You need to limit which products may be purchased from particular vendors.  
  
Which two features should you use? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
The Approved vendor list records which vendors are authorized to supply each product. The Approved vendor check method, defaulted through the item model group, determines the action when a purchase order uses a vendor that is not approved, including blocking the transaction. [Microsoft Learn: Approve vendors for specific products](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/approve-vendors-specific-products) [Microsoft Learn: Source products and materials from multiple vendors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/source-from-multiple-vendors)

**Learn more:** [Approve vendors for specific products - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/approve-vendors-specific-products) · [Source products and materials from multiple vendors - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/source-from-multiple-vendors)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A cement manufacturer uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. The company operates two manufacturing plants. On average, each plant produces 300,000 bags of cement before it must be shut down for maintenance.  
  
The production controller must allocate the required resources during the maintenance period.  
  
You need to configure the system to satisfy the controller’s requirements.  
  
Which two options should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Counters record asset measures such as quantity produced. A maintenance plan can use a Counter maintenance-plan line to schedule preventive maintenance when the registered production quantity reaches the defined interval, such as 300,000 bags. This enables maintenance work to be planned and resourced for each plant.

**Learn more:** [Counters — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-objects/counters) · [Maintenance plans — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-plans)

You must configure the structure for the new perfume line.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Create a new product with tracking dimensions.
Create a new product with storage dimensions.
Set up a new product master and implement serial tracking.

questions.explanation:
A procurement category hierarchy establishes the classification structure used to organize procurement categories and products for procurement processes and analysis. Inventory tracking or storage dimensions, product configurations, and serial tracking do not create that classification hierarchy. Microsoft’s procurement-category setup requires a category hierarchy of type **Procurement** before categories can be configured.

**Learn more:** [Set up a procurement category hierarchy — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/set-up-procurement-category-hierarchy)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for a company that uses bill of materials (BOM) templates to speed up system setup.  
  
A BOM line must be removed, but the system does not permit the deletion.  
  
You need to identify why you cannot delete the line.  
  
Why are you unable to delete the line?

options.text: The BOM template version has already been saved.
The local version of the BOM template has been associated to a service object.
The local version of the BOM template has been modified.
The BOM template has been associated to a service object.

questions.explanation:
A template BOM permits line modification and deletion only while it has not been attached to a service object. After it is attached, the template BOM is protected; changes can be made only to its local BOM version.

**Learn more:** [Template BOMs - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/service-management/template-boms)

questions.question:
Solution: Physical Available displays the quantity that can be sold.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Available physical is the calculated quantity of physical inventory that is not physically reserved. It shows current availability but does not show the timing of incoming supply, so it cannot satisfy a requirement to determine when more product will arrive.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory on-hand list - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-on-hand-list) · [Check the availability of stock - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/check-availability-stock)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Solution: **Ordered** displays the quantities on inbound orders to the warehouse.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, **Ordered in total** represents quantities on inbound orders or positive inventory-journal quantities. It does not by itself show the sellable quantity or the date that additional inventory is expected to arrive; therefore, it cannot satisfy both inventory-availability requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory on-hand list - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-on-hand-list)

questions.question:
Solution: Total Available shows the quantity available for sale at that time.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Total available is a point-in-time calculated quantity: available physical inventory plus total inbound ordered quantity minus total outbound ordered quantity. It does not show when additional product will arrive, so it cannot satisfy a requirement to determine both saleable quantity and future arrival timing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory on-hand list - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-on-hand-list) · [Order promising - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/delivery-dates-available-promise-calculations)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Solution: **On Order** displays the quantities on inbound orders to the warehouse.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The goal is to determine what quantity can be sold now and when more product will arrive. The \"On order\" field only shows the quantity on inbound orders to the warehouse; it does not tell you what is currently available to sell. The field that answers \"how much can I sell\" is \"Available physical\"/\"Total available\" (physical on-hand plus ordered minus on order), so proposing \"On order\" alone does not meet the goal. Therefore the solution does not meet the goal (B, No).\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory on-hand list](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-on-hand-list)

**Learn more:** [Supply schedule - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/supply-schedule)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management master planning. The company intends to run master planning throughout the day. Planning Optimization has not been configured.  
  
The company administrator reports being unable to configure any master-planning features or enable master planning in Dynamics 365.  
  
You need to implement Planning Optimization.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Place the environment into maintenance mode.
Enable the Planning Optimization configuration key.
Set the value of the Use Planning Optimization field to yes.

questions.explanation:
Enabling the Planning Optimization configuration key requires maintenance mode. The prescribed setup sequence is to put the system into maintenance mode, open License configuration, and select the Planning Optimization configuration key; the add-in is installed and Planning Optimization is enabled afterward. Planning Optimization is included with standard Supply Chain Management licensing and does not require separate license activation.

**Learn more:** [Get started with master planning — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/get-started)

questions.question:
Solution: Use the automatically calculated royalty amounts for approval, then create a monthly claim to pay the vendor.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Royalty contract management can calculate royalties from invoiced sales, accumulate claims for a monthly period, and route approved claims to Accounts payable. Processing the claim creates and posts a vendor invoice for the royalty amount, establishing the payable to the third party.\
\
**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a royalty claim in Accounts receivable. Configure the third party as a customer that will receive royalties for use of the logo.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Royalty claims are generated and processed through Accounts payable, where the licensor is paid as a vendor. Processing a royalty claim creates and posts a vendor invoice to the regular Accounts payable process; an Accounts receivable claim for a customer does not meet the requirement to create payable royalty invoices for the third party. [Microsoft Learn: Royalty contract management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)\
\
**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Solution: Create a royalty contract. Set cumulative sales to monthly. Add line items, products, and the value to pay the vendor for use of the logo.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A royalty contract can use a monthly cumulative-sales period, but the resulting royalty claims must also be accumulated and processed to create a vendor invoice in Accounts payable. Contract setup by itself does not create the monthly payable to the third party.\
\
**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Solution: Add line items to a royalty contract for the associated customer, and create sales orders for those items.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Royalty claims are created when qualifying sales-order lines are invoiced. To produce a monthly payable to the licensor, the royalty agreement must use a monthly cumulation period, and the generated claims must be approved and processed as Accounts payable purchase invoices. Adding qualifying contract lines and creating sales orders does not perform those required monthly payable-processing steps.\
\
**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Solution: Add line items to a royalty contract for the associated customer, and create sales orders for those items.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?

options.text: Confirm the load and generate packing slips and bills of lading.
Create waves to generate work for shipping loads and send an ASN.
Confirm shipments and generate pick/put work.
Create work for printing shipping documents and send an ASN.

questions.explanation:
Outbound shipment confirmation is performed after all warehouse tasks for a load are complete and changes the load status to **Shipped**. Packing slips are generated as part of the shipment-completion process; bills of lading are associated shipping documents. Waves and pick/put work are created before shipment confirmation, and an ASN is an advance notice rather than the shipment-finalization action.

**Learn more:** [Warehouse handling of outbound loads for sales, transfer, and outbound shipment orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/outbound-load-handling) · [Pack containers for shipment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/packing-containers)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Review the underlined portion of the statement below to decide if it is correct as written:  
  
"A quarantine order with a status of **Started** means that the item has not yet been placed in the quarantine warehouse."  
  
If the underlined text is already correct, select that no change is needed. Otherwise, choose the option that should replace it.
questions.explanation:
According to Microsoft's documentation on quarantine orders, a quarantine order status of 'Created' is the one that indicates the item has been manually created for quarantine but has not yet been moved into the quarantine warehouse; this generates an issue transaction (On order/Reserved physical/Picked) and a receipt transaction (Ordered/Registered) at the quarantine warehouse. In contrast, a status of 'Started' indicates the inventory has already been transferred from the regular warehouse to the quarantine warehouse, producing Deducted and Received inventory transactions. Since the statement describes the item as not yet being in the quarantine warehouse, the correct status term is 'Created', not 'Started'.

**Learn more:** [Quarantine orders - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quarantine-orders) · [About quarantine orders | Microsoft Learn (Dynamics AX 2012)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamicsax-2012/appuser-itpro/about-quarantine-orders)
