questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You use Planning Optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, with automatic firming enabled.  
  
Because some planned purchase orders are not being firmed as planned, inventory planners must manually process planned purchase orders.  
  
You need to ensure that the planned purchase orders are included in automatic firming.  
  
You open the **Records to include** FastTab.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
The **Records to include** FastTab defines selection criteria for query-based firming, not automatic firming. Automatic firming runs as part of master planning and firms planned orders that meet the configured firming time-fence settings; opening or filtering the query-based firming records does not add orders to that automatic process.

**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. The finance department handles royalty claims through the accounts payable module.  
  
You need to send the claims to the accounts payable group for payment. Which three events will take place? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: A Royalty accrual journal posting reverses the previous interim postings for accrual and expense amounts.
A credit is posted to the vendor's payable account.
A vendor invoice for the royalty payment is set to draft.
A new vendor invoice for the royalty is created and posted.
A hold is put on the amounts held in the royalty fees account.

questions.explanation:
When a royalty claim is processed into regular Accounts Payable, the royalty accrual journal reverses the prior interim accrual-payable and expense amounts. A vendor invoice for the royalty is created and posted; this debits the royalty fees account and credits the vendor’s payable account.

**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
You have been asked to configure inventory cycle counting for a client that uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You need to use a cycle-counting method that lets a worker count items in a warehouse location at any time, without first creating cycle-counting work.  
  
Which option should you use?
questions.explanation:
Spot cycle counting allows a warehouse worker to count items at a location at any time, even when no open cycle-counting work exists for that location.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cycle counting - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cycle-counting)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: For every asset in the work order pool, create a maintenance request with a maintenance request type of Safety. Add the work order pool to the maintenance request, configure the maintenance request to meet the requirements, and change its state to Scheduled.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance requests are manually created notifications of possible maintenance needs; they do not establish recurring daily preventive-maintenance work or automatically create work orders. Maintenance rounds are intended for multiple assets that require similar maintenance and can be scheduled with automatic work-order creation, making them appropriate for the daily safety and calibration checks.

**Learn more:** [Maintenance requests - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/manage-maintenance-requests/maintenance-request-overview) · [Maintenance rounds - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-rounds)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Solution: Create a maintenance round, assign the assets, configure the maintenance round to satisfy the requirements, and schedule the maintenance round.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance rounds support recurring maintenance jobs for a set of assets. Asset lines can be configured with a start date, daily recurrence, and the required maintenance job types; scheduling can run the round regularly. Enabling **Auto create** on both the maintenance round and the scheduling process automatically creates work orders from the round lines.\
\
**Learn more:** [Maintenance rounds - Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-rounds)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a maintenance round, assign the assets, configure the maintenance round to satisfy the requirements, and schedule the maintenance round.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance rounds are designed for preventive maintenance on a group of assets that require related maintenance jobs as part of the same work routine. Maintenance plans are intended for preventive maintenance on individual assets, so a maintenance round—not only a maintenance plan—is required for the daily grouped calibration and safety checks.

**Learn more:** [Preventive maintenance overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/preventive-maintenance-overview) · [Maintenance plans - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-plans)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Create a work order, assign a work order maintenance job to each asset, configure the work order to meet the requirements, and schedule the work order.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Preventive maintenance for a group of assets should use a maintenance round (or suitable maintenance plans) to generate recurring maintenance schedule lines and automatically create work orders. Scheduling a single manually created work order only schedules that work order and does not provide daily recurring, automatic work-order generation from June 1.

**Learn more:** [Preventive maintenance overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/preventive-maintenance-overview) · [Maintenance rounds - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-rounds)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A product is created by using an incorrect product dimension group. The product has not yet been released to any legal entities.  
  
You need to determine whether the product dimension group can be changed.  
  
Which two conditions must be satisfied? Each answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Dimensions must not be specified for the product master.
The item must not already be validated.
Dimensions must be specified that match the original but not the new product dimension group.
The product master must not be released to any legal entities.

questions.explanation: A product master’s product dimension group can be changed only when no product dimensions have been specified for the master and the master has not been released to any legal entity. Created dimensions are tied to the existing dimension-group setup, and release makes the product master available as company-specific released-product data.

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
After warehouse locations are implemented, you are responsible for configuring location directives for inventory movement.  
  
You need to use a location-directive strategy that enables similar items in the warehouse to be identified.  
  
Which of the following strategies should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Consolidate strategy directs an item to a location where similar items are already available, thereby consolidating like inventory in the warehouse.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with location directives - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/create-location-directive)

A company is configuring a warehouse work template by using Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company needs a work template to transfer inventory from its rack location to the pack station during the sales process.  
  
The work template line must be configured as the highest-priority template in the sequence.  
  
You need to configure the detail-line work types for the work template.  
  
Which two line types should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. **(Choose two.)**  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Warehouse work templates for moving inventory between locations use a paired set of operations: **Pick** removes the inventory from the rack location, and **Put** places it at the pack station. Microsoft documentation states that a basic inventory transfer between locations requires at least one Pick operation and one Put operation.

**Learn more:** [Warehouse configuration overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/warehouse-configuration) · [Control warehouse work by using work templates and location directives](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/control-warehouse-location-directives)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The working time template is blank when the period template is set up.  
  
You need to identify the workdays that will be used for inventory replenishment reporting.  
  
Which workdays will be used?
questions.explanation:
When no working time template is specified for a period template, inventory replenishment reporting treats every day of the week as a workday. The report therefore uses a 7-day work week.\
\
**Learn more:** [Calendars and master planning - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/supply-chain-calendars-master-planning)

Sales agreements establish special prices or discounts in exchange for a customer's commitment to purchase a specified quantity or value over time. They do not provide quantity-break discount tiers for individual purchases. Trade agreements support those tiers by defining each quantity bracket with minimum and maximum quantities, so they are required for the 51–100 and 101-or-more discount ranges.

**Learn more:** [Create a new trade agreement - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/create-new-trade-agreement) · [Sales agreements overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-agreements)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company purchases packaging cartons in metric tons and sells them as individual items. The packaging cartons are available in different sizes and are maintained as product variants.  
  
You need to set up unit conversion for the packaging cartons.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the standard unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the inter-class unit conversion feature in the released product.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the standard unit conversion feature in the released products.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the intra-class unit conversion feature in the released product.

questions.explanation:
A conversion from metric tons to individual items crosses unit classes: metric tons are a mass unit, whereas individual items are a quantity unit. When conversion values can differ by carton-size variant, enable unit-of-measure conversions on the product master and configure an inter-class conversion for the released product/variant. Microsoft documents inter-class conversions for units in different unit classes and supports product-variant-specific conversions from released product pages.

**Learn more:** [Unit of measure conversion per product variant](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/uom-conversion-per-product-variant) · [Manage units of measure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/manage-unit-measure)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company receives a large amount of inventory at the warehouse.  
  
The inventory has a short shelf life and must be sent to the stores as quickly as possible.  
  
You need to use Buyer's push to transfer the inventory to the stores.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Select Product and ship open sales orders.

questions.explanation:
Buyer’s push distributes available warehouse inventory to stores. The workflow requires selecting the product and its distribution method, then creating transfer orders to move the allocated quantities to the destination stores.

**Learn more:** [Push products from distribution center to store using buyer's push](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/commerce/tasks/push-products-distribution-center-store-buyers-push)

questions.question:
Solution: Post a picking journal and a report-as-finished journal.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Picking-list and report-as-finished journals are production-order postings: the picking list posts materials consumed by a production order, and report as finished records produced output. Inventory items required for a service order are processed through the associated project as item requirements, so those production journals do not remove and account for items against the service work order.\
\
**Learn more:** [Start a production order](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/tasks/start-production-order) · [Report production orders as finished](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/report-production-orders-as-finished)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a consumption registration and post the work order journal.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Item consumption can be registered on a work order and posted through Work order journals. Posting the item journal records the item consumption and its associated cost on the work order, while accounting for the inventory removed from stock.\
\
**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Solution: Post a picking journal, then post a packing slip.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Work-order materials must be registered as item-consumption lines in the work order journal and posted. This posts the item consumption against the work order; a picking journal and packing slip do not by themselves record item consumption on the work order.\
\
**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Solution: Create a picking registration and then post a picking journal.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Item use on a maintenance work order must be registered and posted as item consumption in the work order journals. Those item journal lines are associated with the work order’s project and generate the material demand and cost attribution for that work order. A picking registration followed by posting a picking journal does not provide that required work-order consumption posting.\
\
**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption) · [Material availability check for work orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/work-orders/material-availability-check-work-orders)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A warehouse picks and ships products.  
  
The warehouse completes work immediately when it is automatically released to the warehouse.  
  
You need to configure waves to enable automatic work creation.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Select the wave template and attribute to automatically process.
Release to warehouse and process the work.
Automate wave creation and process the wave at release to warehouse.
Automate wave creation and automatically process work.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, setting **Automate wave creation** to Yes creates a wave when an order is released to the warehouse, and setting **Process wave at release to warehouse** to Yes automatically processes that wave and creates the work. These settings provide immediate work creation upon release.

**Learn more:** [Wave templates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-templates) · [Release to warehouse - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/release-to-warehouse-process)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
You need to implement the new cost model for the apparel items.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Apparel items using FIFO must have their inventory transactions settled before their valuation model is converted to standard cost. Running Inventory close finalizes FIFO costing and is a required step when changing an item’s item-model-group valuation model from a periodic model to a perpetual model such as standard cost.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq) · [Prerequisites for a standard cost conversion - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/prerequisites-standard-cost-conversion)

questions.question:
You need to implement the new cost model for the apparel items.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure an item sales control for the item.
Enable the customer group in the Activate price/discount form.
Assign the product filter code for the item to the customer tier B customer group.
Assign the item to the customer tier B price group.
Approve and confirm the trade allowance agreement.

questions.explanation:
Customer-tier pricing is configured through customer price groups and group-level sales trade agreements. The customer group must be enabled in the Activate price/discount form so that it can be selected and used for the tier’s price agreements. Microsoft’s trade-agreement guidance states that using the Group customer scope requires customer price groups to be set up.

**Learn more:** [Create a new trade agreement - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/create-new-trade-agreement)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
You need to determine the number of quarantine zones to define.  
  
How many should be defined?
questions.explanation:
Quarantine zones can correspond to inventory locations. Because damaged products must be placed into one of four bins according to product type, four quarantine zones are required—one for each bin—to preserve visibility and segregation during inspection.\
\
**Learn more:** [Quarantine zones for nonconformances - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-quarantine-zones)

questions.question:
You need to set up automated testing for these tasks:  
  
- Inbound processes from manufacturing  
- Outbound processes from warehouse picking  
  
How many processes should you configure?
questions.explanation: A separate quality association is needed for each combination of product testing requirements, sampling percentage, and triggering process. Nutritional supplements and energy drinks have different required tests and different production-completion sampling rates, requiring two manufacturing processes. Their distinct required tests also require separate outbound-picking processes, for a total of four.

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to automatically enforce inbound and outbound product requirements as products enter and leave the warehouse.  
  
Which feature should you use?
questions.explanation:
Quality associations define the transaction triggers, required tests, acceptable quality level, and sampling plan that automatically generate quality orders for inbound and outbound warehouse processes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Quality associations — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations) · [Quality and nonconformance management overview — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-management-processes)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure cycle counting plans and thresholds.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Cycle counting plans create cycle-count work periodically through batch processing, so they can support a weekly schedule. Cycle counting thresholds automatically create cycle-count work when inventory in a location falls below the configured threshold.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cycle counting - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cycle-counting)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure deviation limits and create work pools for cycle-counting work.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Deviation limits control the handling of count variances, and work pools categorize cycle-counting work. They do not schedule weekly count work or trigger count work when inventory falls below a specified level. Those requirements are met by cycle counting plans and cycle counting thresholds, respectively.\
\
**Learn more:** [Cycle counting - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cycle-counting) · [Warehouse configuration overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/warehouse-configuration)

questions.question:
Solution: Set up cycle counting groupings for particular workers and warehouse locations.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation: Cycle counting groupings are used to organize and assign cycle-count work; they do not create scheduled weekly counts or generate counts automatically when inventory falls below defined levels.

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Solution: Set up work generation for sales order posting.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation: Work generation for sales order posting governs warehouse work associated with sales-order processing. It does not schedule weekly cycle counts or automatically create cycle counts when inventory falls below defined levels.

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
A company is using Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Products must be classified automatically according to the company's objectives and priorities.  
  
You need to create the ABC model.  
  
Which three ABC codes should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
The supported ABC classification models group items by their revenue factor, margin factor, or value factor. These correspond to the Margin, Revenue, and Value codes; Cost and Profit are not ABC model options.\
\
**Learn more:** [Run an ABC classification](https://learn.microsoft.com/fr-be/dynamicsax-2012/appuser-itpro/hun-run-an-abc-classification)

questions.question:
You use Planning Optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, with automatic firming enabled.  
  
Because some planned purchase orders are not being firmed as expected, inventory planners must process those planned purchase orders manually.  
  
You want to ensure that the planned purchase orders are included in automatic firming.  
  
You configure **Automatic firming time fence (days)**.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
The automatic firming time fence sets the horizon in which master planning automatically firms planned orders, including planned purchase orders. Planned purchase orders within that configured horizon are automatically firmed when the item is associated with a vendor.\
\
**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

You want to ensure that the planned purchase orders are included in automatic firming.  
  
You configure **Automatic firming time fence (days)**.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
Functional locations provide the hierarchical physical or process structure on which assets such as machines are installed and tracked. They support asset traceability across facilities, including related maintenance activity and costs. Functional location types and lifecycle states or models only define configuration and status behavior; they do not represent the individual tracking locations.

**Learn more:** [Functional locations and assets - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/functional-locations-and-objects) · [Create functional locations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/functional-locations/create-functional-locations)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
You work for a shipping company that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
The business uses several freight carriers. Freight cost is determined by the distance traveled from the source to the destination.  
  
Which two of the following transportation management engines should you include?
questions.explanation:
The Mileage engine calculates the transportation distance between the source and destination. The Rate engine calculates freight rates and can use data from the Mileage engine to calculate a rate based on that distance.\
\
**Learn more:** [Transportation management engines - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/transportation-management-engines)

questions.question:
You must configure the system to support the pottery line.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Set up a new product with product configuration.
Create a new product with tracking dimensions.
Create a new product master with pre-defined product variants.
Create a new product with storage dimensions.

questions.explanation:
A product master is the foundation for product variants. Predefined variants let a single master represent the valid combinations of product dimensions used by a product line, whereas tracking dimensions support batch or serial tracking and storage dimensions control inventory storage and picking.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create predefined product variants - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/create-predefined-product-variants) · [Product dimensions - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-dimensions)

questions.question:
You must configure the system to support the pottery line.  
  
What should you do first?
questions.explanation:
Functional location types define the supporting data for functional locations, including maintenance plans and permitted asset types. A functional location type can automatically apply the required maintenance plan to new functional locations and restrict applicability to vehicle asset types, allowing the location hierarchy to carry the vehicle maintenance schedule without applying it to non-vehicle assets.

**Learn more:** [Functional location types - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-functional-locations/functional-location-types) · [Maintenance plans - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-plans)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
Employee1 needs to configure the new BOM.  
  
Which three actions should Employee1 take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a new BOM for Store1, Store2, and Store3.
Add the raw materials to the BOM and approve the BOM version.
Add the raw materials to the BOM and approve it.
Create a new BOM for Site1 only.

questions.explanation:
A BOM version must be approved before it can be used for planning or manufacturing, and activation makes that approved version the default for its applicable constraints, including site. The BOM must contain its raw-material component lines, and the required setup is limited to Site1.\
\
**Learn more:** [Bills of materials and formulas - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/bill-of-material-bom)

questions.question:
Employee1 needs to configure the new BOM.  
  
Which three actions should Employee1 take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A folio stores the exporter for the goods in an international shipment. Folios support customs declarations and compliance documentation, including cases where the purchase-order vendor differs from the actual exporter; the exporter name and address can be recorded on the folio for tracking and reporting.

**Learn more:** [Manage folios - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/manage-folios) · [Shipping information setup - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/shipping-information-setup)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying the landed cost module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Buyers work with a freight forwarder to arrange inbound shipments, which frequently causes changes to the purchase order header.  
  
The buyers need purchase order lines to update automatically so that mismatches are avoided.  
  
You need to configure the automatic update of purchase order lines when the header changes.  
  
Which module should you use for this configuration?
questions.explanation:
The **Procurement and sourcing** parameters include the **Update order lines** configuration, which determines whether applicable purchase order lines are automatically updated when purchase order header fields change.

**Learn more:** [Procurement and sourcing parameters for Landed cost](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/landed-cost-procurement-parameters)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You use planning optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management with automatic firming enabled.  
  
Because certain planned purchase orders are not firmed as expected, inventory planners must manually process planned purchase orders.  
  
You want to ensure that the planned purchase orders are included in automatic firming.  
  
You configure the Lead Time.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
For Planning Optimization, automatic firming is determined by the planned order’s order (start) date and the configured firming time fence. Lead time is not part of the firming time-fence calculation, so configuring Lead Time does not ensure that planned purchase orders are included in automatic firming. Planned purchase orders also require an associated vendor to be auto-firmed.

**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company categorizes and tracks products according to how useful they are in meeting its business goals. Some product classifications are significant for inventory controls and margins. Other classifications have a low profit margin and are less significant for inventory variances.  
  
The classification setup must feed existing classification reports and system logic.  
  
You need to configure the products for these classifications.  
  
Where should you configure the classifications?
questions.explanation:
The scenario describes ABC classification: products are ranked A/B/C by how significant they are for inventory control and margin (high-value/high-margin vs. low-margin/low-significance items), and these codes feed standard classification reports and system logic such as cycle counting. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management the ABC classification fields (Value, Margin, Revenue, Carrying cost) live on the Released product, under the Manage costs/inventory area, and are populated by the periodic ABC classification job. Product attributes (option C) describe characteristics for catalogs and attribute-based selling, not inventory-control/margin classification, so they would not feed the ABC classification reports and logic. Therefore the classifications are configured on the Released product.

**Learn more:** [ABC classification explained](https://dynamics-tips.com/abc-classification-explained-d365-finance-and-operations/) · [ABC classification in D365 F&O](https://www.waferwire.com/blog/abc-classification-dynamics-365-finance-operations)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the logistics manager for a distribution company.  
  
Your primary carrier service supplies transportation rates between New York City and Colorado. These are flat rates that depend on the pickup city or general area, as follows:  
  
- New York City = $500  
- Colorado = $450  
  
You must configure Transportation Management to calculate the rate from New York City to Colorado.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use a Point-to-Point engine based on weight and miles. Assign rates from New York City as the starting location and Colorado as the ending location and break the rates out based on the weight of the package.
Use a mileage-based rate engine to configure a rate master that calculates the rate based on the miles from New York City to Colorado.
Create hubs for both locations. Add a route plan from New York City to Colorado and assign the two charges as spot rates.
Set up zones in the Zone Master for New York City and Colorado. Assign rates to each zone in the Zone Master by starting and ending location.

questions.explanation:
Zone-based pricing applies fixed carrier charges according to defined geographic areas. Creating zones for New York City and Colorado and assigning the rate by starting and ending zone supports a flat rate determined by the pickup location, without introducing weight- or mileage-based calculations.

**Learn more:** [Transportation management zone master](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/transportation-management-zone-master)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Products need to be classified.  
  
You need to create the ABC model.  
  
Which three ABC codes should you configure? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management provides ABC classification models based on revenue, margin, and value. These models rank products by sales revenue, profitability margin, or inventory value; cost and profit are not supported ABC model types.

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Products need to be classified.  
  
You need to create the ABC model.  
  
Which three ABC codes should you configure? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Maintenance job type variants define variations of a maintenance job type, including period-based variations. A six-month calibration interval is a period variation, so it is configured as a maintenance job type variant. A maintenance job trade instead represents the professional trade and can hold related competency or certificate requirements.

**Learn more:** [Maintenance job types, categories, variants, trades, and checklists — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-work-orders/job-groups-and-job-types-variants-trades-and-checklists)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A caulking manufacturer is implementing Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. When caulking is produced, it is sold in tubes, 1-gallon cans, 5-gallon buckets, 55-gallon drums, or 330-gallon totes, with the potential to add other sizes.  
  
The manufacturer wants to ensure that, when new units are added, only one conversion is configured and conversions between each unit of measure are not required.  
  
You need to configure the unit of measure to meet this requirement.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A base unit within a unit class requires a conversion factor only between the base unit and each additional unit. Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management can then convert between all units in that class, eliminating the need to configure pairwise conversions.

**Learn more:** [Manage units of measure - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/manage-unit-measure)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An organization has two legal entities. One company will sell a new product to the other company.  
  
The company receiving the product must receive a discount on the items during the first three months of initial sales.  
  
You need to configure the system so that the discount is applied for the specified period. What should you do?

options.text: Set the default purchase price on the company that is receiving the product.
Enter the default purchase price on the company that is selling the product.
Set up an intercompany purchase agreement. Do not allow the validity period to be edited.
Set up a Trade Agreement. Set the To Date field to end in three months.

questions.explanation:
Trade agreements can define item-specific discounts for customers or vendors and can limit those discounts by date. Setting the To Date to three months from the start of sales ensures the discount applies only during that period.

**Learn more:** [Price simulation - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/price-simulation) · [Create a new trade agreement - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/create-new-trade-agreement)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are configuring Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for a client.  
  
The client intends to add several items to the Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You must ensure that the client can configure the items as either company-owned or consignment when creating the items.  
  
Which two actions should you take?  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct answer is worth one point.

options.text: You should allocate a moving average costing inventory model.
You should allocate a standard costing inventory model.

questions.explanation:
Consignment inventory remains owned by the vendor until ownership transfers to the receiving legal entity, so the Owner tracking dimension must be active to distinguish vendor-owned from company-owned inventory. Items used in consignment processes must use the moving-average inventory model; standard costing and batch tracking do not provide the required ownership configuration.

**Learn more:** [Set up consignment - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/consignment) · [Moving average - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/moving-average)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is implementing sales order capabilities in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company must fulfill sales orders by using direct delivery.  
  
You need to enter a direct-delivery sales order so that a purchase order is created automatically.  
  
What should you do after entering the sales order and its lines?

options.text: Change the site to direct delivery and confirm the sales order.
Select automatic and confirm the sales order on the line level setup tab in the reservation field.
Change the delivery type on the sales order line to direct delivery and select save.
Set the ship complete toggle to On and confirm the order on the sales order header.

questions.explanation:
A sales order line designated with the **Direct delivery** delivery type is processed as a supplier-to-customer shipment and is linked to the corresponding purchase order. Reservation settings, ship-complete settings, and changing the site do not create that direct-delivery purchase order. Microsoft Learn describes direct deliveries as creating a link between direct-delivery sales order lines and the corresponding purchase order lines.

**Learn more:** [Direct deliveries - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/direct-deliveries) · [Ship orders as direct deliveries - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/ship-orders-direct-deliveries)

questions.question:
A company is setting up Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for its transportation-management needs.  
  
When the company ships a container using a particular route, it must use specified equipment with defined minimum and maximum weights.  
  
You need to configure the equipment and the limits.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A route guide specifies the criteria used to match a load to a route plan, including the required equipment and limits for container weight or volume. It therefore enforces the equipment and minimum/maximum weight requirements for a particular route.\
\
**Learn more:** [Plan freight transportation routes with multiple stops](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/plan-freight-transportation-routes-multiple-stops)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are configuring a royalty agreement and are identifying its royalty-agreement ledger accounts.  
  
Which two of the following ledger accounts should be identified?
questions.explanation:
Royalty agreements require an accrual account and an expense account to receive accrued amounts during the interim stage between royalty-claim approval and processing. The accrual posting credits the royalty accrual account and debits the interim accrued royalty expense account.\
\
**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are configuring a royalty agreement and are identifying its royalty-agreement ledger accounts.  
  
Which two of the following ledger accounts should be identified?

options.text: Set the ship complete toggle to On and confirm the order on the sales order header.
Select automatic and confirm the sales order on the line level setup tab in the reservation field.
Change the site to direct delivery and confirm the sales order.
Select the direct delivery option under the sales order action pane and complete the form.

questions.explanation:
A direct delivery is created from the Sales order page by selecting **Direct delivery** on the Sales order Action Pane and completing the form for the applicable lines. This creates the association between the sales-order lines and the corresponding purchase-order lines, thereby creating the purchase order.

**Learn more:** [Direct deliveries - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/direct-deliveries)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to determine the cause of the inventory issue reported by customer service representatives.  
  
What is the root cause?

options.text: Ordered reserved box should be checked, this will disable quantities.
Ordered reserved quantity is due to marking.

questions.explanation:
Inventory marking links a particular demand transaction to a specific supply transaction. The ordered-reserved quantity represents outbound inventory reserved against ordered receipts, so marking creates the demand-to-supply relationship responsible for that reserved quantity.

**Learn more:** [Inventory on-hand list - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-on-hand-list) · [Inventory marking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/marking)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
A company implements Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and uses the demand forecasting service to generate a statistical baseline forecast for one allocation key at a time.  
  
The process takes too long to finish.  
  
You need to improve the service's performance.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
For demand forecasts generated one item allocation key at a time, enabling **Use request response mode** improves demand forecasting service performance. Storage-account settings are connection and data-storage configuration, not the setting intended to optimize this workload pattern.\
\
**Learn more:** [Generate a statistical baseline forecast - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/generate-statistical-baseline-forecast)

questions.question:
A company implements Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and uses the demand forecasting service to generate a statistical baseline forecast for one allocation key at a time.  
  
The process takes too long to finish.  
  
You need to improve the service's performance.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
On a royalty agreement, the "Cumulate sales by" field defines the period over which the royalty is calculated from cumulative sales. To have a royalty claim generated for each sales order as it is invoiced/fulfilled rather than accumulated over a time period, you select Invoice, which calculates the royalty amount every time a sales order line is invoiced. The royalty claim is created when the sales order is invoiced. "Fulfilled", "Active", and "Shipped" are not valid values for the "Cumulate sales by" field, so Invoice (A) is correct.

**Learn more:** [Royalty contract management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/accounts-payable/royalty-contract)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Three assets at one location each require the same tune-up. One worker can perform all three tune-ups, and that worker’s hours must be allocated to every asset.  
  
You need to configure the system for the worker.  
  
Which configuration should you use?

options.text: Configure a job card for the device.
Create a consumption registration for the items.

questions.explanation:
Work line details support allocating a single worker’s labor across the separate maintenance work associated with each asset. Asset Management can distribute registered work hours across multiple work order jobs, whereas item consumption registrations are for materials rather than labor-hour allocation.

**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption) · [Assets and work orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/objects-and-work-orders)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must segregate the inventory for brakes that are currently in stock.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign a blocked status to the inbound purchase order from VendorA.
Set default inventory status on the item.
Assign a blocked status to the inbound purchase order from VendorB.

questions.explanation:
To segregate brakes that are already in stock you use inventory-status blocking rather than anything that only affects future receipts. You set the item's default inventory status so the brakes carry a controlled/blocked status (C), and you create a disposition code linked to that inventory status so the brakes can be moved to (or held in) the segregated, unavailable status (B). Assigning a blocked status to inbound purchase orders from VendorA or VendorB (A, E) only affects goods still arriving, not stock already on hand, and an item filter code (D) is just for categorization, not for controlling availability.

**Learn more:** [Inventory blocking](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-blocking) · [Inventory statuses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-statuses)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company with two legal entities is implementing Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. Products have no variants. One legal entity will use advanced warehouse management, while the other will not.  
  
The same product will be sold by both legal entities but needs different setup because of the warehousing requirements.  
  
You need to configure the product in both legal entities without duplicating effort or item numbers.  
  
Which method should you use?
questions.explanation:
A released product is the legal-entity-specific instance of a shared product. The same shared product and item number can be released to both legal entities, while each released product can have its own configuration, including warehouse-related setup. Microsoft Learn states that products released to a specific legal entity are released products and that properties and attributes may need to be added per legal entity.

**Learn more:** [Product information overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-information)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A construction-equipment rental company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. Equipment may be rented more than once during its useful life.  
  
The company requires equipment to be set up as assets. The controller must be able to report the cost of each asset and of the group of assets at a single construction site.  
  
You need to set up the financial dimensions.  
  
Where should you configure the financial dimension?
questions.explanation:
Functional locations represent sites and support hierarchical grouping of installed assets. Asset costs follow the asset’s functional location, and financial dimensions assigned to that functional location can automatically update the dimensions on installed assets. This enables cost reporting for an individual asset and for the assets at a construction site.

**Learn more:** [Functional locations and assets - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/functional-locations-and-objects) · [Create functional locations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/functional-locations/create-functional-locations)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Create a quality association with **Reference type** set to **Production** and **Item code** set to **Group**. Create a quality group for every item and assign it to the quality association. Set **Event type** to **Report as finished** and **Execution** to **After**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A production quality association configured for the **Report as finished** event with **After** execution generates quality orders after finished quantities are reported. An association using an item group applies to the products assigned to that group; placing all items in the group would also apply the beverage testing process to energy bars and nutritional supplements, which require separate testing requirements. The group must be limited to beverage items.

**Learn more:** [Quality associations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Create a test group for every beverage item. Create a quality association with **Reference type** set to Production and **Item code** set to All. Assign the test group to the quality association. Set **Event type** to Report as finished and **Execution** to After.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A production quality association with Event type set to Report as finished and Execution set to After can generate quality orders after finished quantities are reported. However, an Item code of All applies the association to all items, so it would also apply the beverage test process to energy bars and nutritional supplements. The association must be limited to the beverage items, such as through an item group.

**Learn more:** [Quality associations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations) · [Quality management for warehouse processes - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-management-for-warehouses-processes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Create a quality association for each item with **Reference type** set to **Inventory**, using **Table** as the item code and specifying every item in the quality associations. Set **Event type** to **Registered** and **Execution** to **Before**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Quality orders for completed production output must be associated with the production process and generated after the item is reported as finished. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, this requires a Production reference type, a Report as finished event type, and After execution; an Inventory association triggered before registration does not satisfy that production-completion requirement. [Microsoft Learn: Quality associations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations)

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Learn: Quality associations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: For each item, create a quality association with **Reference type** set to Inventory, **Item code** set to Table, and the respective item specified on the quality associations. Set **Event type** to Report as finished and **Execution** to After.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Quality associations that create quality orders after production completion must use the **Production** reference type with **Event type** set to **Report as finished** and **Execution** set to **After**. The Inventory reference type does not configure the required production report-as-finished quality process. A shared beverage testing process should also be associated at the appropriate common item-group level rather than through separate item-table associations when the same rule applies to all beverage items.

**Learn more:** [Quality associations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Orders are being reserved against open purchase orders that have not yet been received. Consequently, delivery prioritization issues are causing backorders on both sales orders and transfer orders.  
  
Negative inventory is currently not allowed. Product reservations must be made against physical stock only.  
  
You need to update the product-reservation configuration.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Clear the Reserve Items Automatically check box for transfers.
Clear the Reserve Ordered Items check box.
Select the Auto batch reservations check box.
Select the Physical negative inventory check box.

questions.explanation:
Clearing **Reserve ordered items** prevents reservations against ordered, unreceived purchase-order receipts and limits reservations to items that have been physically received. This satisfies the requirement that product reservations use physical stock only, without enabling negative inventory.

**Learn more:** [Reserve inventory quantities - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/reserve-inventory-quantities)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are using Planning Optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A Planning Optimization job configured with incorrect runtime filters is accidentally started from the user interface, and you must resolve the issue.  
  
Which action should you take?

options.text: You should access the plan history to cancel the job.
You should access the dialog box to cancel the job.
You should access the plan history to rectify runtime filters.
You should access the dialog box to rectify runtime filters.

questions.explanation:
An active Planning Optimization job must be canceled from the plan’s History page. Selecting Cancel in the run dialog box after a job was triggered directly from the user interface does not cancel the Planning Optimization job. Runtime filters are configured for a job in the Planning Optimization run dialog box and apply only to that started or scheduled job.

**Learn more:** [Cancel a planning job — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/cancel-planning-job) · [Run planning for a subset of items — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/plan-filters)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A manufacturing establishment uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
To speed up setup, it uses bill of materials (BOM) templates.  
  
Which of the following statements is TRUE regarding template BOMs? (Choose all that apply.)

options.text: You can only apply a single template BOM to a service object.
You can apply many template BOMs to a service object.
You can modify or delete lines in a BOM template regardless of whether the template has been associated to a service object, or not.
You can modify or delete lines in a BOM template as long as the template has not been associated to a service object.

questions.explanation:
A service object can have only one template BOM applied. Lines in a template BOM can be modified or deleted only if the template has not been attached to a service object; after attachment, changes are limited to the local BOM version.

**Learn more:** [Template BOMs - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/service-management/template-boms)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
You need to add the items from the purchase order to the Intrastat journal.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Transfer the Product Receipt form to the Intrastat journal.
Transfer the invoice to the Intrastat journal.
Create a manual Intrastat journal transaction.

questions.explanation:
Vendor product receipts are eligible source documents for automatic transfer to the Intrastat journal for qualifying intra-EU arrivals. Therefore, transfer the product receipt associated with the purchase order.\
\
**Learn more:** [Intrastat overview - Finance | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/localizations/europe/emea-intrastat)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
You need to add the items from the purchase order to the Intrastat journal.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create one work class ID with valid location types of staging and baydoor. Assign these to the work template details.
Create two work templates: one is a pick/put from inventory to staging and the other is from staging to baydoor.
Create a sales order work template with two pick/put pairs: one to staging and the second to baydoor.
Create two work class IDs: one with valid put location types of staging and the other of baydoor. Assign these to the appropriate put work types on the work template.

questions.explanation:
A staged outbound sales-order process requires one work template with two pick/put pairs: inventory to staging, followed by staging to the baydoor. The pairs use different work class IDs so work can be separated, and each work class restricts its put location type to the applicable destination: staging for the first put and baydoor for the second. Microsoft’s staged-work configuration specifies this same four-line template and the two work classes.

**Learn more:** [Anchoring - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/anchoring) · [Control warehouse work by using work templates and location directives](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/control-warehouse-location-directives)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. The company purchases packaging cartons in metric tons and sells them as individual items. The cartons are available in various sizes and are maintained as product variants.  
  
You need to set up unit conversion for the packaging cartons.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the intra-class unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Disable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the inter-class unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the inter-class unit conversion feature in the released products.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the intra-class unit conversion feature in the released products.

questions.explanation:
A conversion between metric tons and individual items crosses unit classes (weight to quantity), so it requires an inter-class conversion. For product variants, unit-of-measure conversions must be enabled on the product master; the conversion can then be maintained for the released product or released product variant.

**Learn more:** [Unit of measure conversion per product variant - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/uom-conversion-per-product-variant) · [Manage units of measure - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/manage-unit-measure)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A customer negotiated a sales price for 100 items over the next 60 days. Management reviews reports showing how many items the customer has purchased at that price. The customer has an existing order for the agreed sales-agreement quantity. The customer calls to add an extra quantity that exceeds the sales agreement maximum amount. The customer is not eligible for the discounted sales price outside the agreement.  
  
You need to make sure that the customer receives the ordered quantity and that management reporting is accurate.  
  
Which action should you take?

options.text: Modify the sales agreement quantity as unconfirmed.
Edit the sales order quantity and when prompted to save changes, select Yes.
Modify the sales agreement to clear the Max Enforced checkbox and do not confirm.
Create a new sales order for the quantity that exceeds the sales agreement amount.

questions.explanation:
Sales-order lines linked to a sales agreement use its special terms and contribute to that agreement’s fulfillment calculations. When maximum enforcement is used, the combined linked quantity or amount cannot exceed the commitment. Creating a separate sales order for the excess keeps the original 100-item agreement order correctly linked for fulfillment reporting and ensures that the excess is priced outside the agreement.

**Learn more:** [Sales agreements overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-agreements) · [Enter sales agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/enter-sales-agreements)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a retail product catalog.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation: A retail product catalog does not provide the procurement integration that redirects employees to a vendor’s online store for purchase-requisition item selection. An external vendor catalog is used for that procurement process.

questions.question:
Proposed solution: Create a vendor catalog.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An external vendor catalog for PunchOut e-procurement redirects an employee who is preparing a purchase requisition to the vendor’s external site. Items selected in that catalog are returned as shopping-cart or requisition lines, enabling their inclusion in the purchase requisition.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up an external catalog for PunchOut e-procurement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/set-up-external-catalog-for-punchout) · [Use external catalogs for PunchOut e-procurement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/use-external-catalogs-for-punchout)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an external catalog.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An external catalog supports PunchOut e-procurement by redirecting an employee who is preparing a purchase requisition to the vendor’s external site to select products. The selected shopping-cart lines are then returned and added to the purchase requisition.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use external catalogs for PunchOut e-procurement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/use-external-catalogs-for-punchout) · [Set up an external catalog for PunchOut e-procurement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/set-up-external-catalog-for-punchout)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an external catalog.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A procurement catalog in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management is an internal catalog composed of categories and items (added manually, imported, or synced via a web service) that requesters browse from within the purchase requisition form itself — it does not send the user out to a vendor's external website. Redirecting employees to a vendor's own online store to pick items, with the selections then returned to the requisition, requires configuring an External catalog for PunchOut e-procurement (using the Open Catalog Interface/cXML PunchOut protocol), not a procurement catalog. Therefore creating a procurement catalog alone does not meet the stated goal.

**Learn more:** [Set up an external catalog for PunchOut e-procurement - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/set-up-external-catalog-for-punchout) · [Procurement catalogs overview - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365 | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/procurement-catalogs)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A warehouse picks and ships products.  
  
The warehouse completes work immediately when it is automatically released to the warehouse.

options.text: Select the wave template and attribute to automatically process.
Select the wave template and assign it to recurring batch job.
Automate wave creation and process the wave at release to warehouse.
Select the wave template and process the wave at release to warehouse.

questions.explanation:
Setting **Process wave at release to warehouse** to Yes on the applicable wave template automatically processes the wave and creates work as each line is released to the warehouse. This provides immediate work creation during release rather than leaving the wave for later manual or scheduled processing.

A distribution company plans to configure barcodes in its Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system for warehouse scanning.  
  
Barcodes will be manually entered.  
  
You need to reduce the risk of barcode-entry errors.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Select an item and set up security on the barcode field.
Create a new barcode, enter the value, select the type, and enter the size and max length.
Create a new barcode, enter the value, select the type, and enter the mask.

questions.explanation:
A barcode definition should include its type, size, and maximum length. The maximum-length setting constrains barcode entries to the expected character length, helping prevent manual-entry mistakes such as values that are too long or otherwise incorrectly formatted.\
\

questions.question:
A distribution company plans to configure barcodes in its Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system for warehouse scanning.  
  
Barcodes will be manually entered.  
  
You need to reduce the risk of barcode-entry errors.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create new finished goods and release to the legal entity. Raw material products are not required for these items.
Create new finished goods with predefined variants and release to the legal entity.
Create new raw materials with variants and release to the legal entity.
Create new raw materials and release to the legal entity.
Create new finished goods and release to the legal entity.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, predefined product variants are defined as valid combinations of product dimensions for a product master. Products must be released to the relevant legal entity before they are available there as released products. Raw materials that do not require product-dimension combinations should be created and released without variants.

**Learn more:** [Product information overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-information)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company purchases packaging cartons in metric tons and sells them as individual items. The packaging cartons are available in different sizes and are maintained as product variants.  
  
You need to set up unit conversion for the packaging cartons.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the intra-class unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Disable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the inter-class unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the standard unit conversion feature in the released products.
Disable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the intra-class unit conversion feature in the released products.

questions.explanation: In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, intra-class and inter-class unit conversions configured in Organization administration are global, class-based rules meant to apply uniformly across items sharing a unit of measure class, which does not fit a scenario where the ton-to-each conversion ratio differs by carton size variant. Because the ratio is specific to each product variant, the correct approach is to enable unit of measure conversions on the product master and then define standard (item-specific) unit conversions on the released product record for each packaging carton variant, allowing each variant to carry its own accurate conversion factor between mass and count.

While testing your organization's newly implemented Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management procurement module, you observe that when an item is received, no transactions are being posted to the product receipt journal.  
  
You need to fix this problem.  
  
Which action should you perform on the Item model group setup form?

options.text: You should consider un-checking the Include physical value checkbox.
You should consider checking the Include physical value checkbox.
You should consider un-checking the Accrue liability on product receipt checkbox.
You should consider checking the Accrue liability on product receipt checkbox.

questions.explanation: The 'Accrue liability on product receipt' checkbox on the Item model group determines whether the system generates the ledger accrual and journal transactions when a product receipt is posted for a purchase order. If it is left unchecked, receiving the item updates inventory quantities but does not generate the expected financial posting to the product receipt journal. Enabling (checking) this option ensures that the accrued liability transaction is posted at the time of product receipt, which resolves the missing journal postings.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to manage its warehouse.
