questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has inventory items that use two costing methods: FIFO and Standard.  
  
At month end, the company must calculate the cost of every item and give the finance department the total inventory value.  
  
You need to identify the overall value of inventory.  
  
Which costing method requires the inventory close to be run?

options.text: LIFO, Moving Average, and Date Weighted Average items

questions.explanation:
Inventory close (closing) settles issue transactions against receipts and is required only for periodic inventory valuation methods: FIFO, LIFO, LIFO date, weighted average, and weighted-average date. Standard cost and moving average are perpetual methods that do not use inventory close; their values are adjusted with inventory revaluation instead. In this scenario the company has FIFO and Standard items, so only the FIFO items require inventory close to be run (B). "FIFO and Standard" (A) is wrong because Standard cost never needs a close, and the LIFO/moving-average/weighted-average option (C) doesn't match the company's methods.

**Learn more:** [Inventory costing FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],This is a case study. Case studies are not independently timed. You may use as much of the exam time as you want to complete each case. However, this exam may contain additional case studies and sections. You must manage your time so that you can complete every question on the exam within the allotted time.  
  
To answer the questions in a case study, you must refer to the information supplied in that case study. Case studies can include exhibits and other resources that provide further information about the scenario described. Every question in this case study is independent of the others.  
  
At the conclusion of this case study, a review screen appears. This screen enables you to review and change your answers before moving to the next exam section. After you start a new section, you cannot return to this section.  
  
To begin the case study:  
  
To show the first question in this case study, select the **Next** button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the case-study content before answering the questions. Selecting these buttons displays information such as business requirements, the existing environment, and problem statements. If the case study includes an **All Information** tab, the information on that tab is identical to the information on the subsequent tabs. When you are ready to answer a question, select the **Question** button to return to the question.  
  
**Background**  
  
Coho Vineyard & Winery is a parent company with two subsidiaries: Coho Vineyard and Coho Winery. Coho Vineyard is located in Medford, Oregon. The vineyard grows the grapes, then produces and bottles the wine. Coho Winery, located in Grants Pass, Oregon, distributes packaged wine to businesses and consumers. In addition to wines, the winery sells imported cheese and olive oil.  
  
**Current environment: Technology landscape**  
  
- Coho Vineyard & Winery requires financial reporting from both Coho Vineyard and Coho Winery. The parent company consolidates the financials in a third-party tool.  
- Coho Winery currently manages inventory and financials in spreadsheets that are separate from the parent company.  
  
**Current environment: Inventory and warehousing**  
  
- The complete warehouse is temperature controlled. A refrigerated area of the warehouse is used for items that need colder storage.  
- Items have no fixed warehouse locations.  
- Coho currently uses smart numbering for cheese items. The items begin with **F** for France and **U** for the United States, as follows:  
  - `F11234` = French cheese  
  - `U14567` = US cheese  
- Wine currently does not use smart numbering.  
- Inventory is valued by using First In, First-Out (FIFO).  
- Olive oil has a shelf life of 12 months.  
- WineA is costly and is not stocked regularly in the warehouse.  
- WineB must be stored in the refrigerated section of the warehouse.  
- WineC is non-refrigerated wine and represents most of the inventory in the warehouse.  
  
**Current environment: Vendors and procurement**  
  
- Cheese is bought from vendors in two countries: France and the United States.  
- Non-cheese items can be purchased from vendors in other countries or regions.  
- Olive oil is purchased and sold in full cases of six each.  
- When Coho Vineyard produces more wine than expected in a season, rebate programs are offered to any company whose monthly purchases exceed $5,000.  
  
**Requirements: General**  
  
- The Coho Vineyard & Winery parent company, and Coho Vineyard, will not be included in the implementation of Dynamics 365 Finance and Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for Coho Winery. They plan to implement these as separate legal entities during the next five years.  
  
**Requirements: Inventory and warehousing**  
  
- Items must be renumbered in the new system.  
- Separate item numbers must be used for every imported item to enable simplified reporting by source country or region.  
- Advanced Warehouse Management capabilities must be enabled in the new system.  
- Each bottle of wine has one item number.  
- The vintage of each bottle changes annually and can affect the bottle cost. This cost must be tracked by year.  
- Some wine bottles require refrigeration. The system must automatically determine where items must be stored in the warehouse.  
- Wine must be organized in a hierarchy such as the following:  
  - Red  
    - Cabernet  
    - Merlot  
  - White  
    - Chardonnay  
    - Pinot  
- Inventory value must be stored at the end of every month.  
- Every month, the olive-oil inventory on hand is evaluated. Any oil with fewer than six months remaining of shelf life is sold to a discount retail store. If fewer than 90 days remain of shelf life, the olive oil is donated or destroyed.  
- At least 20 cases of olive oil, and no more than 50 cases, must be on hand and not reserved for forthcoming customer orders.  
- WineB must be refrigerated.  
  
**Requirements: Vendors and procurement**  
  
- The cheese smart-numbering system will not be used in the future. Instead, the system must use standard configurations to ensure that the correct cheese items are used for the appropriate country or region when ordering.  
- Olive oil must be managed only in full cases, although inventory cost must be calculated as cages.  
- If any bottle of olive oil in a case is broken, the cases will be sold at a discounted price.  
- Vendor rebates must be calculated and submitted as a claim.  
- Rebate programs are passed on to the retailers that sell Coho Winery wines. The rebates must be claimed from Coho Vineyard.  
- Purchase orders (POs) must be maintained online, with changes tracked between vendors and buyers.  
- The controller determines that WineA must not be held in financial inventory on Coho Winery’s books. The winery agrees with the vendor that the vendor will own WineA until a later date.  
- Vendor1 sends bulk shipments. Coho Winery does not always have sufficient warehouse staff to receive inventory. The company requires Vendor1 to send advanced shipping notices (ASNs).  
- The operations coordinator must schedule inbound loads. The company requires inbound-load creation to be automated where possible.  
  
**Issues**  
  
- The warehouse is at maximum capacity. Empty bin locations are not always available.  
- The warehouse manager wants to create fast-moving floor locations for WineB and refill locations in higher rack storage.  
- Coho Winery recently performed an internal audit risk assessment. The assessment found that inventory value reports were kept in spreadsheets. The spreadsheets are easily edited and have insufficient controls.  
- After olive oil is counted, several cases are destroyed because of shelf life. The inventory planner must decide whether to place a new PO for olive oil.  
- Vendor rebate claims are frequently rejected because claims were calculated incorrectly by excluding discounts.  
- The purchasing manager receives multiple complaints about POs:  
  - Issue 1: PO changes are not accepted and confirmed, which causes out-of-stock issues.  
  - Issue 2: Vendors do not control responses to POs. Instead, vendors rely on emails.  
  
You must configure the olive oil case requirements.  
  
Which two configurations should be used for PO creation through MRP? Each correct answer provides part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set standard validation on default order quantities.
Set strict validation on default order quantities.
Set the inventory unit of measure to cases.
Enter multiples on default order settings.

questions.explanation:
The purchase-order Multiple setting in default order settings is used by master planning when it generates planned purchase orders, so setting the multiple to the six-unit case size constrains planned purchases to whole cases. The unit configuration wizard establishes the necessary units and conversion between the inventory-costing unit and the purchasing case unit, allowing olive oil to be purchased only by case while retaining the required inventory-cost calculation unit.

**Learn more:** [Default order settings for dimensions and product variants](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/default-order-settings) · [Manage units of measure](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/manage-unit-measure)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A manufacturing company is implementing Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and plans to relocate an existing manufacturing facility to a larger facility soon.  
  
The company has these requirements:  
  
- The existing facility must be configured to manage fixed assets.  
- The new facility must be preconfigured in the system and ready for the transition.  
  
The controller is concerned that users could use the preconfiguration before the transition.  
  
You need to configure the system to minimize the risk of use before the transition.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A functional location lifecycle state controls whether a functional location is active. Configure the new facility in an inactive lifecycle state while it is being prepared, then change it to an active state at the transition. This preserves the preconfiguration while preventing the new Asset Management functional location from being active prematurely.

**Learn more:** [Functional location lifecycle states - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-functional-locations/functional-location-stages)

You are the logistics manager for a distribution company.  
  
Your primary carrier service supplies transportation rates between New York City and Colorado. The rates are flat amounts based on the pickup city or general area, as follows:  
  
- New York City = $500  
- Colorado = $450  
  
You must configure Transportation Management to calculate the rate from New York City to Colorado.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set up zones in the Zone Master for New York City and Colorado. Assign rates to each zone in the Zone Master by starting and ending location.
Using the Point-to-Point engine with an empty break master, assign rates based on starting and ending locations.
Create a Point-to-Point based Rate Master with the rates broken out by pieces.
Create a Shipping carrier and service. Create carrier accessorial charges to represent the rates for each location.

questions.explanation:
A Point-to-Point rate setup with an empty break master is designed for a flat charge selected by the starting and ending locations. A break master is used to define pricing tiers and breakpoints; because this rate has no such tiers, no break values are required. Microsoft Learn describes break masters as defining pricing structures and breakpoints, while rate-base assignment metadata can determine which rate base applies by destination or service.

**Learn more:** [Set up rate masters, rate bases, and break masters - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/tasks/set-up-rate-masters) · [Transportation management engines - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/transportation-management-engines)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company that uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management has recently obtained ISO 9001 certification.  
  
The company must start documenting nonconformances.  
  
You need to configure the nonconformance functionality.  
  
Which three features must be configured? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Nonconformance management requires quarantine zones to identify where nonconforming material is held, diagnostic types to classify diagnostic actions for corrections, and operations to define the work performed to resolve an approved nonconformance. Quality charges are optional, and production routes are unrelated to nonconformance operations.

**Learn more:** [Enable quality and nonconformance management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/enable-quality-management) · [Operations for nonconformances](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-operations)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company operates several warehouse locations and acquires a new warehouse. You must design a new warehouse process workflow for this new warehouse.  
  
You need to configure the workflow. Which three options should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Core Warehouse Management workflow configuration includes work pools, work templates, wave templates, and location directives. Work pools organize warehouse work, work templates define the work operations, and wave templates define the outbound release and wave-processing criteria. Cluster picking is an optional picking strategy, while outbound wave processing is a workflow capability governed by wave-template configuration.

**Learn more:** [Warehouse configuration overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/warehouse-configuration) · [Wave templates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-templates)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Under a vendor agreement, the company must assume ownership of items when they ship. The items must be included in inventory valuation but must not be available for sale until they are physically received at the warehouse.  
  
You need to configure the system to satisfy the vendor's requirements.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Landed cost supports goods-in-transit processing, including taking ownership when goods leave the shipping port. While the goods are in transit, they are not available inventory and cannot be picked for delivery; receipt at the destination warehouse completes the process.

**Learn more:** [Goods-in-transit processing and receiving - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/in-transit-processing)

Solution: Create a maintenance round for the vehicle fleet and a maintenance plan for the box maker.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance rounds support recurring preventive work across a group of assets, such as servicing a vehicle fleet. A faulty component requires reactive maintenance, typically initiated by a maintenance request or repair work order; a maintenance plan is primarily used to schedule preventive maintenance.\
\
**Learn more:** [Preventive maintenance overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/preventive-maintenance-overview) · [Creating work orders](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/creating-work-orders)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a maintenance round for the vehicle fleet and a maintenance plan for the box maker.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance rounds support recurring preventive tasks for a group of assets, such as servicing a vehicle fleet. A maintenance plan defines preplanned preventive work, whereas an unexpected faulty component requires reactive maintenance, typically initiated through a maintenance request and work order. Therefore, assigning a maintenance plan to the box-maker repair does not satisfy the reactive-maintenance requirement.

**Learn more:** [Preventive maintenance overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/preventive-maintenance-overview) · [Maintenance plans - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-plans)

questions.question:
Solution: Create maintenance plans for the vehicle fleet and the box maker.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance plans define scheduled preventive maintenance work, such as recurring oil and tire service. An unexpected faulty component requires reactive corrective maintenance, typically initiated by a maintenance request and addressed through a corrective work order; therefore, maintenance plans for both requirements do not meet the goal.\
\
**Learn more:** [Maintenance plans - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-plans) · [Creating work orders - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/creating-work-orders)

questions.question:
Solution: Create maintenance plans for the vehicle fleet and the box maker.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance plans support scheduled preventive maintenance, such as regular vehicle tire and oil changes. A maintenance round is also a preventive-maintenance feature for similar work on several assets; it is not the appropriate mechanism for an unplanned repair of a faulty box-maker component. Reactive maintenance should be initiated through a maintenance request or corrective work order.

**Learn more:** [Preventive maintenance overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/preventive-maintenance-overview) · [Creating work orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/creating-work-orders)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Solution: Create maintenance rounds for both the vehicle fleet and the box maker.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Maintenance rounds support recurring preventive work for several assets requiring similar maintenance at regular intervals. A faulty component requires reactive corrective maintenance, which is handled through a maintenance request and subsequent work order rather than a maintenance round.\
\
**Learn more:** [Maintenance rounds - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/maintenance-rounds) · [Creating work orders - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/preventive-and-reactive-maintenance/creating-work-orders)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A large item fits only one unit per pallet. A purchase order for this item must have a minimum quantity of 24. Any additional line quantities for the item must be multiples of 24.  
  
An incorrect item setup permits entry of multiples of 50. This setup error results in purchase-order-entry overrides.

Your company uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You must adjust inventory. In addition, the current item posting configuration must be overridden.  
  
You use the counting journal.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
A counting journal posts an inventory receipt or issue when the counted quantity differs from the on-hand quantity, thereby adjusting inventory. When a counting reason code has an offset account assigned, posting a counting journal line that uses that reason code posts to the assigned offset account rather than to the default inventory posting profile account, which overrides the standard posting configuration.

**Learn more:** [Reason codes for inventory counting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/reason-codes-for-counting-journals) · [Count inventory in a warehouse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/count-inventory-warehouse)

A company uses advanced warehouse functionality in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A high-demand, batch-tracked item caused delays on sales orders. The vendor delivery is expected today.  
  
Sales orders must remain on hold until the items have passed quality checks.  
  
You need to configure batch attributes that enable warehouse processing while holding sales orders.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Unavailable status, block reservation, picking and shipping
Unavailable status, block picking and shipping
Available status, block reservation, picking and shipping

questions.explanation:
An unavailable batch disposition status can be customized by order operation. Leaving reservation unblocked allows the incoming batch to be processed and allocated, while blocking sales-order picking and shipping prevents the batch from being released to customers until quality inspection is complete.

**Learn more:** [Use batch disposition codes to mark batches as available or unavailable](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/batch-disposition-codes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company runs a chain of retail coffee shops along with a distribution center. Every coffee shop and the distribution center is a separate warehouse.  
  
Cups and lids are replenished from one distribution center.  
  
You need to set up store replenishment for coffee cup lids.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set the coverage plan by dimension for warehouse on the Storage dimension group.
Set the minimum item coverage to the safety stock quantity. Set the maximum to the maximum quantity of stock to reorder above the safety stock quantity.
Set the minimum item coverage to the safety stock quantity. Set the maximum item coverage to 0.
Create a coverage group assignment for the item.
Set the minimum item coverage to 0. Set the maximum item coverage to the number of lids to keep on hand.

questions.explanation:
Warehouse must be enabled as a coverage-planning dimension so that supply and demand are planned separately for each coffee-shop warehouse. A coverage group can be assigned to an item, including through item coverage when the assignment is dimension-specific. Under Min/Max coverage, the minimum represents the safety-stock threshold, and when projected inventory falls below it, master planning replenishes inventory to the configured maximum level. A maximum of zero would not establish the intended replenishment target.

**Learn more:** [Coverage settings — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/coverage-settings) · [Safety stock fulfillment for items — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-replenishment)

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A customer returns a defective product in exchange for a replacement.  
  
You need to process the return order.  
  
Which three actions should be performed? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a return of type Credit Only
Set the deadline date according to the company policy
Create a credit note for the replaced product
Set the delivery address to the customer's address in the return order
Create a return of type Physical Return
Set the deadline date to the date the customer returns the defective product

questions.explanation:
A defective product that the customer sends back must use a Physical return order; Credit only does not require the product to be physically returned. The return deadline is the final date on which the item may be returned and is calculated from the configured validity period, so it should follow company policy. Completing a replacement-and-credit return includes issuing the customer credit for the returned product.

**Learn more:** [Sales returns - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-returns) · [Specify how to dispose of returned items - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/specify-how-to-dispose-of-returned-items)

You need to resolve UserC’s issue.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Change the inventory status and run the replenishment process.
Change the inventory status and complete a movement journal.
Create a transfer order and change the inventory status.

questions.explanation:
Inventory at a location with open warehouse work cannot have its inventory status changed. After the related movement work is completed or canceled, the inventory status can be updated; inventory status changes are normally performed during the warehouse movement process.\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company produces and sells custom bicycles. Customers can customize certain components to create a custom bicycle.  
  
You need to configure sales orders to support the permitted customization for custom bicycle orders.  
  
What are two possible methods to achieve this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a sales order for the bicycle and make configuration selections on the order for the upgraded seat and handlebars. The production order will be automatically generated with the correct seat and handlebars.
Create a sales order for the bicycle and add separate line items for the upgraded seat and handlebars.
Create a sales order for the bicycle. Modify the production order after it has been reported as finished to delete the standard seat and handlebars and add the upgraded seat and handlebars.
Configure the product to allow for the seat and handlebars selection to be defined at order creation, automatically adding an upcharge to the sales price.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management product configuration models allow products to be configured on sales orders and create distinct variants with BOM lines that vary according to selected attributes. They also support attribute-based sales price models, so selected options such as upgraded seats and handlebars can automatically change the sales price. Separate component sales lines do not inherently alter the bicycle’s production BOM, and changes made after production is reported as finished cannot configure the manufactured bicycle.

**Learn more:** [Product configuration models overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-configuration-models) · [Set up attribute-based pricing for configurable products - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/set-up-attribute-based-pricing-configurable-products)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to manage its inventory.  
  
The company discovers an incorrect inventory quantity for Item 33442 in Warehouse 1.  
  
You need to correct the inventory quantity by using the posting setup configured on the item group.  
  
Which two journal types accomplish this goal? Each correct selection provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation: Inventory adjustment journals directly correct on-hand quantities, while inventory counting journals reconcile the recorded quantity to a physical count. Both post inventory changes by using the inventory posting configuration associated with the item group.

You must configure the limited-edition bicycle to satisfy the requirement for its official release date.  
  
Where should this be configured?
questions.explanation:
A product lifecycle state can block the Sales order business process, preventing a released product or variant from being added to a sales order until its lifecycle state is changed to one that permits sales. This provides the required control over availability before the official release date.\

options.text: On the Mobile device menu items form, select an option for the Directed by field.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. It manages inventory by using a just-in-time approach.  
  
A purchase order arrives for an item. The system must allow sales order shipments for that item to be posted before the purchase order invoice is received.  
  
You need to make sure the item model group configuration permits shipment of the items.  
  
Which parameter should you enable?
questions.explanation:
A sales order packing slip is a physical inventory issue. Enabling Physical negative inventory allows items to be picked, packed, and sold when available physical on-hand inventory would otherwise be insufficient. Financial negative inventory applies to financial posting, such as sales-order invoicing before related purchase orders have been invoiced.

**Learn more:** [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq) · [Physical and financial updates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/physical-financial-updates)

Which categorization should be used?

options.text: 80% of the items make up 20% of the revenue
80% of the items make up 80% of the revenue
5% of the items make up 35% of the revenue
20% of the items make up 80% of the revenue
20% of the items make up 20% of the revenue

questions.explanation:
Pareto-based ABC analysis classifies A items as the small, high-value group requiring the greatest control and most frequent review. Under the 80/20 distribution, 20% of the items generate 80% of the revenue or inventory value.

**Learn more:** [Inventory Control – ABC analysis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics-gp/distribution/inventory2)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the planner at a distribution company.  
  
You notice an increase in planned orders for item C0001. You must track the source of these planned orders and separate them according to their demand. You are not concerned with safety stock maximums for this item.  
  
You need to ensure that the master-planning batch job creates a unique planned purchase order for each new demand requirement for C0001.  
  
Which coverage code should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Requirement coverage code creates one planned purchase, transfer, or production order for each product requirement, preserving demand-level traceability. It is appropriate when every new demand requirement must produce its own planned purchase order, rather than aggregating demand by period or replenishing to inventory minimum/maximum levels.

**Learn more:** [Coverage settings - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/coverage-settings) · [Replenishment methods and quantity modification - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/replenishment-methods-quantity-modification)

questions.question:
You must recommend a process for planned orders that will not be firmed.  
  
What should you recommend?

options.text: Set the planned order to Completed
Remove the planned order from selection

questions.explanation:
A planned order that will not be firmed should have its status changed to **Completed**. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management specifies Completed as the status for planned orders that are not to be firmed; Approved is used for orders intended to be firmed.\
\
**Learn more:** [Maintain planned orders — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/maintain-planned-orders)

Your company manages sales forecasts through Dynamics 365 Sales.  
  
You are creating a customer record for a new customer in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You need to use an existing quote to create a sales order. You are preparing to define the customer and create the sales order.  
  
Which of the following combinations of actions should you take?

options.text: You should create Customer from Lead, and confirm the quote.
You should convert Lead to Customer, and confirm the sales order.
You should create Customer from Lead, and confirm the sales order.
You should convert Lead to Customer, and confirm the quote.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management’s prospect-to-cash process, converting a prospect to a customer creates the customer account. Confirming the sales quotation creates the sales order from that quotation. Sales-order confirmation is a separate action that occurs after a sales order exists.

**Learn more:** [Work with prospects in prospect-to-cash with Dynamics 365 Sales](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/fin-ops/data-entities/prospects-in-prospect-to-cash-use) · [Create and edit sales quotations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/tasks/create-edit-sales-quotations)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
You work for a distribution company that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are responsible for planning and want to use a planning engine that lets orders be firmed automatically based on the order date.  
  
Which of the following options would you use?
questions.explanation:
Planning Optimization supports automatic firming based on the planned order’s order date (start date). By contrast, the deprecated master planning engine bases automatic firming on the requirement date (end date).\
\
**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

questions.question:
You work for a distribution company that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are responsible for planning and want to use a planning engine that lets orders be firmed automatically based on the order date.  
  
Which of the following options would you use?

options.text: Enter a manual forecast for the initial stock levels at the retail stores.
After the first month of face mask sales, look at the warehouse sales orders for the past 30 days to generate a demand forecast.
After the first month of face mask sales, review store sales for the past 30 days to generate a demand forecast.
After the first month of face mask sales, create a forecast for the warehouse and a second forecast for the retail stores.
After the first month of face mask sales, create a manual forecast for the warehouse and automatically generate a demand forecast for the stores.

questions.explanation:
A manual forecast supplies the initial expected demand when there is no historical sales data for the new item. After sales have occurred, a statistical demand forecast should be generated from the stores’ historical sales demand. Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management generates baseline demand forecasts from historical transactions and supports warehouse as a forecast dimension, allowing demand to be planned at the relevant store locations.

**Learn more:** [Demand forecasting overview - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/introduction-demand-forecasting) · [Demand forecasting setup - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/demand-forecasting-setup)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company is repeatedly short of inventory for a group of produced finished-good items, causing customer-service problems.  
  
You need to make sure production orders are created automatically when inventory is low.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
The item minimum defines the safety-stock threshold. When master planning detects that projected inventory will fall below this minimum, it creates a planned replenishment order; for a produced item, this is a planned production order that can be firmed into a production order. A safety stock journal calculates proposed minimum coverage quantities from historical transactions and posts them to item coverage. The maximum quantity only controls the quantity to replenish to when Min/Max coverage is used, rather than defining the low-stock threshold.

**Learn more:** [Safety stock fulfillment for items - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-replenishment) · [Use the safety stock journal to update minimum coverage for items](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-journal)

You work for a distribution company that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
To improve the consistency of forecasting data, you plan to use demand forecasting.  
  
You must ensure that your strategy enables planned orders to be created automatically during the master-planning process according to the need or end date.  
  
Which action should you take?

options.text: You should push data into the staging table.
You should make use of safety stock calculations.
You should generate a statistical baseline forecast.
You should make use of demand forecast details.

questions.explanation:
A statistical baseline forecast generates demand forecasts from historical data. When the forecast model is included in a master plan, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management uses the forecast requirements to generate planned orders that supply the forecasted demand. Demand forecast details only provides forecast information and adjustment capabilities.

**Learn more:** [Master planning with demand forecasts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/demand-forecast) · [Generate a statistical baseline forecast](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/tasks/create-baseline-forecast)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company needs to create new items that may be company-owned or vendor-owned.  
  
You need to create and configure the items so they can be used as company-owned inventory or consignment inventory.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Assign a non-stock service item model group
Assign a moving average costing inventory model
Activate batch dimension and assign a standard costing inventory model
Activate owner dimension and assign a standard costing inventory model

questions.explanation:
Consignment inventory is owned by the vendor while it is stored at the receiving company’s site. The Owner tracking dimension separates vendor-owned inventory from inventory owned by the receiving legal entity, and items used in consignment processes must have that dimension active. A standard-cost item model group provides the stated costing configuration.

**Learn more:** [Set up consignment — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/consignment) · [Prerequisites for standard costs — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/mt-mt/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/prerequisites-standard-costs)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An employee at a company is responsible for warehouse operations and for controlling inventory adjustments through journals.  
  
The employee must add inventory for samples at a specified cost. A vendor shipped the samples without a purchase order. The employee must ensure that the inventory value is posted to a ledger account so the sample value is not combined with other inventory value.  
  
You need to ensure that the employee can add the inventory correctly.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a movement journal, add the cost, and specify the offset ledger account on the line.
Create an adjustment journal, add the cost, and specify the offset ledger account on the line.
Create an arrival journal, add the cost, and specify the offset ledger account on the line.
Create a transfer journal, transfer to a different warehouse, and then adjust the cost.

questions.explanation:
An inventory movement journal supports adding inventory at a specified cost and manually assigning a general ledger offset account. This lets the sample inventory value be posted separately instead of using the default inventory posting account. [Microsoft Learn: Inventory journals](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journals)

Solution: On the **Quality orders** page, create a quality order for the quantity that must be blocked.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Creating a quality order blocks the quantity specified on that order by creating an inventory blocking record. The blocked quantity is physically reserved, preventing other outbound transactions from reserving it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-blocking) · [Quality orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-orders)

questions.question:
Solution: On the **Item sampling** page, select the **Full blocking** option.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Full blocking setting in item sampling blocks the entire order-line quantity during quality inspection, regardless of the sampling quantity. The blocked physical inventory cannot be reserved by other outbound transactions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-blocking)

questions.question:
Solution: Manually create a transaction on the inventory blocking page.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A manually created transaction on the Inventory blocking page blocks available physical on-hand inventory, preventing it from being reserved by other outbound source documents.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and maintain an inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/create-maintain-inventory-blocking) · [Inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-blocking)

questions.question:
Solution: Set up a blocking cause in the inventory setup configuration.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A blocking cause is descriptive setup metadata and does not itself block any on-hand quantity. Physical inventory is prevented from reservation by outbound source documents when an inventory blocking record is created for the relevant item and quantity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and maintain an inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/tasks/create-maintain-inventory-blocking) · [Inventory blocking - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-blocking)

options.text: Use a Point-to-Point engine based on weight and miles. Assign rates from New York City as the starting location and Colorado as the ending location and break the rates out based on the weight of the package.
Using the Point-to-Point engine with an empty break master, assign rates based on starting and ending locations.
Create a Point-to-Point based Rate Master with the rates broken out by pieces.
Set up A Transit Time Engine to track days from New York City to Colorado. Set up rates in the Rate Master tied to day breaks.

questions.explanation:
A flat carrier charge that depends solely on the origin and destination should use the Point-to-Point rate engine with no break criteria. An empty break master avoids adding weight, distance, piece-count, or time-based tiers, while the rate entries can be assigned by starting and ending locations. Microsoft documents that break masters define tiered pricing breakpoints and that rate-base assignments support destination- and service-specific price points.

**Learn more:** [Set up rate masters, rate bases, and break masters - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/tasks/set-up-rate-masters)

A company has revenue items that generate high, medium, or low revenue.  
  
You need to configure ABC classifications as shown:  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783786634104-tzpezis2.png)  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer forms part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Define highest, middle, and lowest ABC values as percentages
Define highest, middle, and lowest ABC values as amounts

questions.explanation:
Revenue-based ABC classification requires the Revenue ABC model. The A (highest), B (middle), and C (lowest) classes are defined by percentage thresholds, which must total 100%.\
\
**Learn more:** [Run an ABC classification](https://learn.microsoft.com/fr-be/dynamicsax-2012/appuser-itpro/hun-run-an-abc-classification)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the materials manager for a distribution company.  
  
You must set up ABC classification for every item as follows:  
  
- Class A materials account for 70 percent of the material value.  
- Class B materials account for 20 percent of the material value.  
- Class C materials account for 10 percent of the material value but are the most frequently used.  
  
You need to assign an ABC classification value model to all items by using these values.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Run the ABC classification periodic task to update the value model for all items
Manually update the Value classification on the Released product record
Run the ABC classification periodic task to update the revenue model for all items

questions.explanation:
The ABC classification periodic task calculates and assigns classifications for the selected items. Selecting the Value model groups items by their value factor and applies the configured A, B, and C percentage thresholds; the Revenue model instead classifies by revenue. A report does not perform the bulk classification update.

**Learn more:** [Run an ABC classification](https://learn.microsoft.com/fr-be/dynamicsax-2012/appuser-itpro/hun-run-an-abc-classification)

questions.question:
A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and evaluating its available capabilities.  
  
The company has these requirements:  
  
- Track one inbound vessel that includes multiple shipping containers.  
- Track the route from the origin to the destination.  
  
You need to identify which landed cost functionality can satisfy these requirements.  
  
Which landed cost function should you use?
questions.explanation:
A journey defines the physical path that inbound goods follow from the origin to the destination, and each landed-cost voyage is assigned to a journey. A voyage can represent a single vessel containing multiple shipping containers, while the journey supplies its route and legs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Landed cost vs. Transportation management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/landed-cost-vs-tms)

You need to identify which landed cost functionality can satisfy these requirements.  
  
Which landed cost function should you use?

options.text: Manually move product to the correct physical location.
Log into a desktop computer and update the Inventory module.
Manually find the physical location of the product.
Scan a shelf barcode and update the inventory.

questions.explanation:
To correct a recorded warehouse location from a mobile device, the worker must determine where the product is physically stored and scan the shelf/location barcode to register that actual location in inventory. Warehouse mobile movement workflows support worker-directed inventory location updates and barcode-based data capture.

**Learn more:** [Set up a mobile device menu item for moving items in the warehouse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/mobile-device-movement-menu)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You identify a new vendor.  
  
You must create a purchase agreement for the vendor that includes direct invoicing and insurance.  
  
You need to create a classification for the purchase agreement.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set the value for Certification to Yes. Set the value for Requires direct invoicing to No.
Set the value for Certification to No. Set the value for Requires direct invoicing to No.
Set the value for Certification to Yes. Set the value for Requires direct invoicing to Yes.
Set the value for Certification to No. Set the value for Requires direct invoicing to Yes.

questions.explanation:
Insurance policies and bonds on purchase agreements require the **Certifications** setting, and direct invoicing requires **Require direct invoicing** to be enabled. Therefore, both values must be set to **Yes**.

**Learn more:** [Procurement and sourcing in the public sector — Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/public-sector/procurement-sourcing-public-sector) · [Set up purchase agreement classifications in the public sector — Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/public-sector/tasks/set-up-purchase-agreement-classifications-public-sector)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work for a distribution company that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are responsible for planning. When you notice that planned orders for a specific item are increasing, you plan to track the source of the planned orders and release them according to their demand.  
  
You want to ensure that the master planning batch job creates a unique planned purchase order for each new demand requirement for the item.  
  
You configure the Per period coverage code as the lot-sizing method.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
The Per period coverage code combines all demand for an item within a defined period into one planned order. It cannot ensure a unique planned purchase order for each individual demand requirement; that one-to-one behavior is provided by the Per requirement coverage code.

**Learn more:** [Coverage settings - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/coverage-settings)

You work for a distribution warehouse that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
After receiving a large quantity of stock with a limited shelf life, you must distribute the stock to retail outlets as soon as possible.  
  
You plan to use Buyer's push. Which of the following option should you choose?

options.text: You should generate a sales order.

questions.explanation:
Buyer’s push is used to allocate and distribute available products from a distribution center to one or more stores. The resulting movement of inventory between the warehouse and retail outlets is handled through transfer orders. Microsoft Learn documents Buyer’s push as a process for distributing products from one location to one or many stores.

**Learn more:** [Push products from distribution center to store using buyer's push](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/commerce/tasks/push-products-distribution-center-store-buyers-push) · [Integrate Supply Chain Management transfer orders with Intelligent Order Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/intelligent-order-management/integrate-transfer-orders)

You must configure the system to meet the inventory-costing requirement.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each answer represents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: one default item group for all items
one item group each for perfume, ceramicware, and other goods
one FIFO item model group and one Standard item model group
one financial dimension for each item group

questions.explanation:
Item model groups define the inventory valuation method, including FIFO and Standard cost, so separate FIFO and Standard item model groups are required. Separate item groups for perfume, ceramicware, and other goods allow inventory posting and related accounting configuration to be maintained by item category.

**Learn more:** [Cost management home page — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/cost-management-home-page) · [Prerequisites for a standard cost conversion — Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/prerequisites-standard-cost-conversion)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work for a distribution company that uses a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are responsible for planning. After noticing that planned orders for a specific item are increasing, you plan to track the source of the planned orders and release them according to their demand.  
  
You want to ensure that the master-planning batch job creates a unique planned purchase order for each new demand requirement for the item.  
  
You configure the **Per requirement** coverage-code lot-sizing method.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
The Per requirement coverage code causes master planning to create a planned purchase, transfer, or production order for each individual requirement of an item. When the item’s planned order type is purchase, this produces a distinct planned purchase order per new demand requirement, preserving demand-specific traceability.

**Learn more:** [Coverage settings - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/coverage-settings)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You configure purchasing policies and manage purchasing processes for a company.  
  
Users frequently submit requisitions containing incorrect information. They also choose non-approved vendors or incorrect categories.  
  
You need to configure a procurement policy that restricts the procurement categories and vendors that can be selected.  
  
Which two policy rules should you configure? Each correct answer provides part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A Category access policy rule determines the procurement categories available to employees when they create requisitions. A Category policy rule defines how vendors can be selected for each category, including restricting selection to approved vendors. [Set up policies for procurement category hierarchies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/set-up-policies-procurement-category-hierarchies)

**Learn more:** [Set up policies for procurement category hierarchies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/set-up-policies-procurement-category-hierarchies) · [Purchasing policies overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-policies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management in one legal entity that includes Site1 and Site2.  
  
ItemA is a configured item with configurations ConfigA and ConfigB. The business has decided to stop purchasing ItemA ConfigB for Site2 but will continue purchasing it at Site1.  
  
You must configure ItemA so that the purchasing rules are enforced.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Default order setting rules support settings at the product-variant and site level, including the stop flag used for purchase orders. A site- and variant-specific rule can therefore prevent purchases of ItemA ConfigB at Site2 without preventing purchases at Site1.

**Learn more:** [Default order settings for dimensions and product variants](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/production-control/default-order-settings)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and has implemented procurement categories.  
  
Purchase requisitions are required when purchasing procurement-category goods.  
  
You need to ensure that the company buys office supplies from only one specific vendor.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add the preferred vendor to the office supplies procurement category setup
Create a preferred trade agreement for the office supplies vendor
In purchasing policies, configure a specific category policy for office supplies
In purchasing policies, create a Purchase requisition control rule
Configure the purchase requisition workflow to specify the office supplies vendor

questions.explanation:
Mark the specified vendor as the preferred vendor for the office supplies procurement category, and configure a Category policy rule in the applicable purchasing policy to control vendor selection for that category on consumption purchase requisitions. The category policy can require selection from preferred vendors, thereby limiting office-supplies requisitions to the designated vendor when it is the only preferred vendor.

**Learn more:** [Approve vendors for specific procurement categories - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/approve-vendors-specific-procurement-categories) · [Set up policies for procurement category hierarchies - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/mt-mt/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/set-up-policies-procurement-category-hierarchies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Planning Optimization in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A new item is configured for production with a bill of materials (BOM) and is included in Planning Optimization.  
  
You need to identify the planning output for the item.  
  
Which two components are part of the output? Each answer represents a partial solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
For an item whose planned order type is Production, master planning generates planned production orders and includes the active BOM. BOM explosion creates supply requirements for the materials needed to produce that item; purchased components are represented by planned purchase orders. Action messages apply to changes to existing planned, approved, or firmed orders, rather than being the normal new-item planning output.

**Learn more:** [Production planning - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/production-planning) · [Action messages - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/action-messages)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A manufacturing company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The procurement manager updates minimum stock levels by using the safety stock journal. While calculating the proposal for the minimum inventory level by using the service level option, the manager encounters a setup error.  
  
You need to identify the cause of the error.  
  
What caused the error?

options.text: The Multiplication factor value was left blank.
Safety stock journal lines were created by including the current month’s transactions.
The Use the calculated minimum quantity as the new minimum quantity option was not used.
The Lead time margin value was left blank.
The Calculate standard deviation option was not used while creating the journal lines.

questions.explanation:
A service-level safety-stock proposal depends on the standard deviation calculated when the safety stock journal lines are created. The **Calculate standard deviation** option must be set to Yes to use the **Use service level** proposal option.

**Learn more:** [Use the safety stock journal to update minimum coverage for items](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-journal)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has recently implemented a Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management system.  
  
You are now configuring inventory-item costing methods. You need to use a method that is normally applied to items with a limited shelf life.  
  
Which of the following costing methods should you use?
questions.explanation:
FIFO assumes that the earliest inventory receipts are issued or sold first. This is suitable for items with a limited shelf life because the oldest goods should be used before they pass their sell-by date. In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, FEFO can be used separately as an expiration-based reservation technique, but it is not itself a costing methodology.

**Learn more:** [Design details: Costing methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-nz/dynamics365/business-central/design-details-costing-methods) · [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying the Warehouse management module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company will receive an item in three units of measure (UOM): each, case, and pallet. A warehouse worker must be able to count the item from a mobile device using the each UOM or the case UOM only.  
  
You need to configure the item.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Create a reservation hierarchy and define the rules.
Set the default inventory unit of measure to each and the default purchase and sell unit to case.
Create one unit sequence group and enable counting per unit of measure.
Set the default inventory unit of measure to each and assign the default item set up to case.
Create separate unit sequence groups, one for case counting and one for each counting.

questions.explanation:
A unit sequence group defines the UOM sequence used in warehouse operations. On that group, the **Use unit for cycle counting** setting selects which UOMs are available for counting on the mobile device. Configure one group containing each, case, and pallet, and enable counting for each and case only.

**Learn more:** [Unit of measure and stocking policies - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/unit-measure-stocking-policies) · [Cycle counting - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cycle-counting)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company purchases packaging cartons in metric tons and sells them as individual items. The packaging cartons are available in several sizes and are maintained as product variants.  
  
You need to set up unit conversion for the packaging cartons.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the standard unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Disable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the inter-class unit conversion feature in the Organization administration module.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the standard unit conversion feature in the released products.
Enable unit of measure conversions in the product master. Configure the intra-class unit conversion feature in the released products.

questions.explanation:
Unit-of-measure conversion must be enabled on the product master to support conversions for its product variants. Variant-specific conversions can be configured from Released product details, allowing each carton-size variant to use its own conversion rule. Microsoft Learn documents enabling the setting on the product master and accessing Unit conversions from Released product details or Released product variants.

**Learn more:** [Unit of measure conversion per product variant - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/uom-conversion-per-product-variant)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for wave processing.  
  
The system must automatically create a wave when a sales order is released to the warehouse.  
  
You need to configure the system to fulfill this requirement.  
  
Which configuration should be enabled?
questions.explanation:
In a wave template, setting **Automate wave creation** to **Yes** automatically creates a wave when an order or kanban is released to the warehouse. **Assign to open waves** adds released lines to an existing wave, **Process wave automatically at threshold** processes waves once defined thresholds are met, and **Automate wave release** releases an already-created wave.\
\
**Learn more:** [Wave templates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-templates)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for wave processing.  
  
The system must automatically create a wave when a sales order is released to the warehouse.  
  
You need to configure the system to fulfill this requirement.  
  
Which configuration should be enabled?

options.text: Freeze time fence on master plan

questions.explanation:
Planning Optimization bases automatic firming on a planned order’s order date (start date). The Automatic firming time fence (days) sets the horizon in which planned purchase orders are automatically firmed, and lead time affects the order’s start date. The requirement date is not the firming date basis for Planning Optimization, while a freeze time fence controls whether planned orders can be changed during planning runs rather than enabling firming.

**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

options.text: Read the release notes and master planning entries in the Microsoft Ideas portal.
Finish relevant material requirements planning system configurations and data imports and run a fit analysis.
Identify the gaps through the known issues in Lifecycle Services.
Upload all task recordings for MRP business processes into Azure DevOps for analysis.

questions.explanation:
Planning Optimization fit analysis runs against the current master-planning configuration and data to flag places where the planning service might ignore the setup or where processes are unsupported. Completing the relevant material requirements planning configurations and importing the required data before running the analysis enables it to identify implementation-specific gaps.

**Learn more:** [Planning Optimization fit analysis - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planning-optimization-fit-analysis) · [Optimize your implementation by using fit-to-standard and fit-gap analysis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/guidance/implementation-guide/process-focused-solution-fit-to-standard-fit-gap-analysis)

A company operates Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management with a single legal entity.  
  
The company frequently creates and adds new items manually. Many of these items need the same configuration as existing items. The company needs a streamlined process that copies fields from another item during creation and enables other employees to use that same process.  
  
You need to configure the simplified process.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
A shared item (product) template provides predefined field values for new released products and can be created from an existing item’s setup. Shared templates are available to other users, whereas personalization affects only the user interface and product masters are intended for products with variants.

**Learn more:** [You can't apply a template to create a released product](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/supply-chain/products/cant-apply-template-create-released-product)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Solution:  
  
- Create a purchase agreement with the **Product value commitment** type.  
- Add a line for item **C0001**.  
- Enter a product value of **$15,000** and set an expiration date one year from now.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Product value commitment records a committed currency amount for a specific product, not a committed item quantity. It also does not provide a unit-price field for the agreement line. To track fulfillment of 5,000 C0001 speaker cables at $3.00 per cable, the agreement must use a Product quantity commitment with a quantity of 5,000 and a unit price of $3.00.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchase agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements) · [Create a purchase agreement - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/create-purchase-agreement)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
Proposed solution: Create a purchase agreement for the vendor with a product quantity commitment. Include the quantity, price, and expiration date.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A purchase agreement with a product quantity commitment records an agreed quantity for a specific item, supports a unit price, and uses an expiration date to define the commitment’s validity. Purchase-order quantities linked to the agreement contribute to fulfillment, allowing the commitment to be tracked.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchase agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements) · [Create a purchase agreement - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/create-purchase-agreement)

questions.question:
Solution: Set the released product price to $3.00. On the **Purchase** FastTab, add the vendor in the **Vendor account** field.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Purchase agreements are used to commit to a specified product quantity with a vendor over time, apply the agreed price, define the agreement’s validity period, and track fulfillment through related purchase-order lines. A released-product price and vendor account alone do not establish the 5,000-unit commitment, one-year expiration, or fulfillment tracking.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchase agreements - Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements) · [Create a purchase agreement - Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/tasks/create-purchase-agreement)

questions.question:
Solution:  
  
- Create a trade agreement journal of type **Price (purch.)**.  
- Add a line for item C0001 for the vendor.  
- Enter a unit price of $3,00 for a quantity up to 5,000, and enter an expiration date for next year.  
  
Does this solution fulfill the goal?
questions.explanation:
A purchase agreement with a product quantity commitment is needed to track fulfillment of the 5,000-unit commitment. Purchase-order quantities or amounts contribute to fulfillment of a purchase-agreement commitment, whereas a purchase trade agreement only supplies pricing conditions and does not track the committed quantity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Purchase agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are implementing containerization functionality.  
  
You must automate containerization so that containers and picking work for shipments are generated when a wave is processed. Work lines must be split into quantities that fit the required containers by size.  
  
You need to configure a container build template that defines the containerization process.  
  
Which three items must you set up before creating the container build template? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: a wave template that includes the containerize method

questions.explanation:
Container types define the physical dimensions and capacity used to create containers, and container groups organize those types in the packing sequence. A shipping wave template must include the containerization method to create picking work during wave processing. The container build template selects the container group and uses a wave step code to link its processing to the wave template. Container packing policies concern packing-station workflows, and the packing strategy is selected as a setting on the build template itself.

**Learn more:** [Containerization - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-containerization)
