lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A client wants to use Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to help process intercompany trade.  
  
You need to ensure that payments for intercompany sales orders are processed correctly when intercompany payable journals are posted.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: In the intercompany trade parameters for sales order policies, select Post journal automatically
In the intercompany trade parameters for purchase order policies, select Post invoice automatically
In the intercompany trade parameters for purchase order policies, select Post journal automatically
In the intercompany trade parameters for sales order policies, select Allow summary update of documents for original customer

questions.explanation:
To automatically process the intercompany receivable payment when the corresponding accounts payable payment journal is posted, configure the intercompany sales order policy and select **Post journal automatically**. This setting creates and posts the accounts receivable payment journal for the intercompany customer payment.

**Learn more:** [Register payments automatically for intercompany customer invoices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/intercompany-register-customer-payments-automatically)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company intends to produce its profit and loss statements by using the site storage dimension.  
  
If the site is changed on a sales order, purchase order, or another source document, a mismatch occurs between the financial and storage dimensions. This results in incorrect profit and loss reporting.  
  
You need to ensure that the financial dimension is updated when the site storage dimension changes.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Associate the financial dimension hierarchy with the storage dimension hierarchy in the organization chart.
On the storage dimension site setup screen, select Default inventory status ID.
Associate the site storage dimension with the site financial dimension.

questions.explanation:
A financial dimension link associates the Site inventory dimension with a financial dimension and assigns the corresponding value to each site. Activating the link causes new transactions to use the financial-dimension value configured for the site. Locking the link updates open transactions and enforces the site-linked financial-dimension value, preventing postings and edits that would leave the financial and storage dimensions mismatched.

**Learn more:** [Configure and manage financial dimension links to sites](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/financial-dimension-links)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work for a distribution company that uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You are responsible for planning. When you observe that planned orders for a particular item are increasing, you plan to track the source of the planned orders and release them according to their demand.  
  
You want to ensure that the master planning batch job creates a unique planned purchase order for each new demand requirement for the item.  
  
You configure the Min/Max coverage code lot-sizing method.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
The Min/Max coverage code replenishes inventory to the defined maximum quantity when projected available inventory falls below the minimum quantity. It does not create a distinct planned purchase order for every demand requirement. The Per requirement coverage code provides demand-specific planned orders, creating one planned purchase, transfer, or production order for each requirement.

**Learn more:** [Coverage settings - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/coverage-settings) · [Safety stock fulfillment for items - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/safety-stock-replenishment)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and gives warehouse workers handheld devices for carrying out inventory operations.  
  
Periodic inventory audits are necessary because some warehouse inventory items are frequently stolen. Some inventory items have been completely depleted. The on-hand quantities for other items are consistently inaccurate.  
  
You need to configure the system to automatically generate cycle-counting work.  
  
Which two methods can you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Cycle-counting thresholds automatically create counting work when an item quantity or percentage reaches its configured limit, including when a location becomes empty. Cycle count plans automatically create counting work immediately or periodically through a batch process. Work pools organize assigned work but do not cause it to be created automatically.

**Learn more:** [Cycle counting - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cycle-counting)

questions.domain: Implement and manage supply chain processes
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are the inventory manager for a large distribution company.  
  
You have noticed that item P0001 regularly runs out, and its on-hand quantity appears to differ from the quantity in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. You want cycle count work to be automatically created when the quantity falls below 10 pieces, which occurs about once each week.  
  
You need to configure warehouse management appropriately to generate cycle count work.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a cycle count plan for item P0001 to run when the quantity is below 10.
Create a cycle count threshold that is percentage based that will generate work when inventory drops below 10% for item P0001.
Create a cycle count threshold that is quantity based and specify 10 for the quantity. Add P0001 as a selected item.
Create a cycle count plan for item P0001. Generate a batch job that runs once a week.

questions.explanation:
A quantity-based cycle count threshold creates cycle count work automatically when an item’s inventory quantity falls below the specified threshold. Setting the threshold to 10 and selecting P0001 directly implements the required trigger; a cycle count plan is intended for immediate or periodic batch-scheduled work rather than a quantity-drop trigger.

**Learn more:** [Cycle counting - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/cycle-counting)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A retailer using Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management performs master-planning runs that average 300,000 items in a single planned-order run.  
  
Optimizations are required to improve performance. Most items in the master-planning runs have no dependencies on other items.  
  
Planning multiple items together in a single group will improve performance.  
  
You need to configure the system to increase performance.  
  
Which configuration should you use?

options.text: Number of tasks in a helper bundle
Number of orders in a firming bundle

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, **Number of tasks in a helper bundle** controls the number of items planned together by a single helper. Increasing this bundle size is recommended when the item count is very large—on the order of hundreds of thousands—and is especially suitable when most items are independent, because grouping them reduces task-management overhead.

**Learn more:** [Improve master planning performance - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/master-planning-performance)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Three assets at one location each require the same tune-up. One worker can complete all three tune-ups, and the worker’s hours must be allocated to every asset.  
  
You need to configure the system for the worker.  
  
Which configuration should be used?

options.text: Create a consumption registration for the expenses.
Create a consumption registration for the items.
Create one work order and split hours by work order job.

questions.explanation:
A single work order can include multiple work order jobs, each defining work performed on an asset. The **Split hours** function distributes one worker hour-registration line evenly across the work order jobs, allocating the labor hours to each of the three assets.

**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption) · [Assets and work orders - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/objects-and-work-orders)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A warehouse picks and ships products.  
  
The warehouse completes work immediately when it is automatically released to the warehouse.  
  
You must configure waves to enable automatic work creation.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Select the wave template and assign it to recurring batch job.
Release to warehouse and process the work.
Automate wave creation and process the wave automatically at threshold.
Automate replenishment and process the wave at release.

questions.explanation:
Work is created only when a wave is processed. To make work be created automatically without user intervention you configure the wave template to Automate wave creation (a wave is created automatically as soon as an order line is released to the warehouse) and to process that wave automatically. Setting Process wave automatically at threshold (with minimal thresholds) causes the wave to process immediately, generating the work right away. Option D (automate replenishment) addresses replenishment, not the creation of picking work, so it does not satisfy the requirement to enable automatic work creation.

**Learn more:** [Wave templates (Microsoft Learn)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-templates) · [Wave creation and processing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wave-processing)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses transportation management to manage outbound shipments to customers.  
  
The company fulfills customer orders directly from multiple warehouses. A customer asks to receive an order as one unified shipment. Products must be consolidated from multiple warehouses, rather than sending one shipment from each warehouse.  
  
You need to configure the component that consolidates the loads before they are sent to the customer.  
  
Which component should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Transportation Management hub consolidation is designed for sales orders fulfilled from different warehouses for the same customer. Loads are routed to a configured hub, consolidated there into a new load, and then delivered to the customer as one shipment.

**Learn more:** [Plan loads using hub consolidation overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/plan-loads-hub-consolidation)

questions.domain: Implement warehouse management and transportation management
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company manufactures and sells speaker boxes. The speaker boxes may be silver or black and have either a basic or upgraded wiring harness assembly.  
  
The speaker box must be created in the item master so that the color and harness-type variables can be assigned during order entry.  
  
You need to create a new item that supports multiple variables.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new product. Select predefined variant as the configuration technology.
Create a new product master. Select constraint-based configuration as the configuration technology.
Create a new product. Select constraint-based configuration as the configuration technology.
Create a new product master. Select predefined variant as the configuration technology.

questions.explanation:
A product master is required to support multiple product variants. Predefined variants are appropriate when the valid, discrete combinations of product dimensions—such as color and harness type—are known and can be defined in advance. Constraint-based configuration instead uses a product configuration model to describe attributes, components, and their constraints.

**Learn more:** [Product information overview — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-information) · [Create a product master — Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/create-product-master)

A blocked Damaged inventory status categorizes the affected on-hand inventory and prevents it from being used in production, sales, transfer, or outbound transactions while it remains physical inventory. An inventory movement journal records inventory movement without removing the stock from inventory, enabling the damaged stock to remain on hand and be valued separately for accounting.

**Learn more:** [Inventory statuses - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-statuses) · [Inventory journals - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/inventory-journals)

A company with multiple legal entities is implementing the landed cost module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The controller needs the general ledger postings for cost type codes to be consolidated across companies during month-end close.  
  
You need to configure the cost type code.  
  
Which two prerequisites must you configure? Each correct answer represents part of the solution. (Choose two.)  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
To share landed-cost cost type codes among legal entities, configure a shared cost type table and a shared chart of accounts. Cost type codes contain ledger posting information, and Microsoft states that sharing the cost type table without also sharing the chart of accounts causes posting transactions to fail or work incorrectly.

**Learn more:** [Costing parameter values setup - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/costing-parameters-setup)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. Inventory is valued using standard cost, which is updated only once each year.  
  
The company wants to change its costing method from standard cost to moving average.  
  
You need to convert the items from standard cost to moving average.  
  
Which three actions must you take? Each answer provides part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Adjust the inventory quantity to zero
Adjust the inventory cost to zero

questions.explanation:
To convert an item from standard cost to moving average, inventory quantity and inventory value must both be adjusted to zero. After both are zero, the item must be assigned an item model group whose inventory model is Moving average.

**Learn more:** [Moving average - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/moving-average)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and plans to implement landed cost.  
  
The company must be able to assign statuses that inform users about a specific voyage.  
  
You need to configure voyage statuses for the applicable cost areas.  
  
Which three cost areas should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Voyage status values can be assigned at the shipping-container, folio, and purchase-order levels of a voyage. Each of these cost areas has its own set and hierarchy of voyage statuses; vendor and vessel are not supported voyage-status cost areas.\
\
**Learn more:** [Voyage status setup - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/voyage-status-setup)

You are implementing warehousing in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You need to configure and approve a warehouse that can be used to create additional warehouses.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: inventory and warehouse management parameter setup

questions.explanation:
A warehouse configuration template captures a warehouse setup so it can be reused when creating additional warehouses. Microsoft Learn identifies warehouse configuration templates as appropriate when rolling out warehouse setup or creating a new warehouse in the same legal entity.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up a warehouse by using a warehouse configuration template](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/warehouse-template)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
A customer has placed multiple sales orders and requires that the orders ship on one truck.  
  
You need to configure the system to consolidate the multiple outbound sales orders onto one truck for delivery.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A load groups order lines or shipments that are transported together on a single transportation unit, such as a truck. An outbound load can include quantities from multiple sales orders, enabling their delivery on the same truck. [Warehouse handling of outbound loads](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/outbound-load-handling)

A company is deploying asset management in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company manually assigns workers to work orders, and maintenance quality is declining because of that manual assignment process.  
  
The company needs preferred maintenance workers to be assigned to a specific work order according to defined criteria.  
  
You need to assign workers to work orders.  
  
Which criterion should you use?
questions.explanation:
Preferred maintenance workers can be configured to match work orders by asset type. During work-order scheduling, Asset Management uses the most specific matching preferred-worker setup to select an available worker.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up preferred maintenance workers - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/work-order-scheduling/preferred-maintenance-workers)

options.text: Create one coverage group for raw materials and one for finished goods.
Set the item coverage manual flag on the warehouse to Yes.
Create separate coverage groups for raw materials, finished goods, and retail packaging.
Set the item coverage manual flag on the warehouse to No.
Create one coverage group for retail packaging items and another for items in the warehouse.

questions.explanation:
Coverage groups hold the Master Planning settings that determine how item requirements are calculated, so raw materials, finished goods, and retail packaging require separate coverage groups when their replenishment policies are managed independently. Clearing the warehouse item-coverage Manual flag allows items in that warehouse to be included automatically in requirements planning and reordering.

**Learn more:** [Coverage settings - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/coverage-settings)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],An employee at a company must lay out the various components needed to build custom bicycles.  
  
You need to determine which constraints the employee should use to configure the bicycles.  
  
Which two types of constraints should the employee use? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: table constraints that are used generically among product configuration models
expression constraints that are used generically among product configuration models
expression constraints that are unique to each product configuration model
table constraints that are always unique to each product configuration model

questions.explanation:
Table constraint definitions can be used generically in product configuration models. Expression constraints are written for a specific component in a product configuration model and cannot be reused or shared with another component.

**Learn more:** [Expression constraints and table constraints in product configuration models](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/expression-constraints-table-constraints-product-configuration-models)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
You are tasked with configuring an agreement that gives clients a specified per-unit discount when they purchase a particular quantity of a specific item. The parameters are:  
  
- 51 to 100: 10% per unit  
- 101 and more: 15% per unit  
  
You configure a purchase agreement.  
  
Does this action meet your objective?
questions.explanation:
Purchase agreements are contracts between an organization and its vendors for the organization’s purchases. Customer purchases with special prices or discounts are governed by sales agreements; therefore, a purchase agreement cannot implement the required client quantity-discount arrangement.

**Learn more:** [Purchase agreements - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements) · [Sales agreements overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/sales-marketing/sales-agreements)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Asset Management to handle maintenance requests.  
  
The company needs automatic assets to be created for a functional location.  
  
You need to configure the required data.  
  
Which two configurations should you use? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Automatic creation of an asset on a functional location requires a functional location type configured with an asset type and a functional location lifecycle state configured with **Create asset** set to Yes. The lifecycle-state change then creates and installs the asset using the functional location’s ID and name.

**Learn more:** [Install assets on functional locations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/functional-locations/install-objects-on-functional-locations) · [Functional location types](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/setup-for-functional-locations/functional-location-types)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],CompanyA is a wholesaler that is implementing Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
CompanyB is a retailer with multiple retail stores and one centralized distribution center. CompanyA receives a separate sales order for every CompanyB retail store. The sales orders must be shipped together to the centralized distribution center, while each retail-store order is picked and packed separately.  
  
You need to configure the system so that CompanyB's requirements are fulfilled through CompanyA's outbound shipments.  
  
Which two features should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Container mixing constraints can use the sales order as the constraint, ensuring that items from one retail-store order are packed into a separate container even when multiple orders are consolidated into one shipment. A location profile is required for packing locations and must support license-plate tracking so the system can control the container-packing process. Space utilization only projects warehouse capacity, and system grouping is an open-work-list feature rather than a shipment-packing control.

**Learn more:** [Container packing strategies - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/container-packing-strategy-overview) · [Pack containers for shipment - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/packing-containers)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A buyer submits a purchase requisition for item C0001 from a new vendor.  
  
All purchases from a new vendor must pass through an internal workflow-approval process.  
  
You must ensure that a purchase order (PO) is created automatically from the purchase requisition. Which setup is required?

options.text: Status = approved, item = C0001, vendor populated on the PO
Status = in review, item = C0001, vendor populated on the purchase requisition
Status = approved, item = C0001, vendor populated on the purchase requisition
Status = draft, item = C0001, vendor populated on the PO

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, a purchase requisition proceeds through workflow from Draft to Approved, and approved requisitions can generate purchase orders automatically. The vendor must be populated on the purchase requisition so that the automatically created PO has a supplier; a PO cannot be populated before it is created.

**Learn more:** [Purchase requisition workflow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-requisitions-workflow) · [Purchase requisition overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-requisitions-overview)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and uses weighted average date as its costing model.  
  
The controller requires receipt costs to be used throughout the month, until the month-end close procedure is performed.  
  
You need to configure the item model group.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution. *(Choose two.)*  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Select the Include physical value checkbox.

questions.explanation:
For the weighted average date inventory model, selecting **Include physical value** makes physically updated receipts contribute to the running-average (estimated issue) cost during the period. The inventory close subsequently performs the weighted-average calculation using financially updated receipts. The item model group must also have the applicable inventory model selected.

**Learn more:** [Weighted average date with Include physical value and marking](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/weighted-average-date) · [Options for including physical value in cost calculations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/include-physical-value)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses the built-in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management master-planning engine. Planned orders are automatically firmed during the current week.  
  
You need to reconfigure the system for the new Planning Optimization master-planning engine.  
  
What should you change?

options.text: firming time fence to one week
firming time fence to lead-time plus one week
open orders' firming date to be the requirement date
firming time fence to be longer than the lead time

questions.explanation:
Planning Optimization bases automatic firming on the planned order’s order (start) date, so lead time does not need to be included in the firming time fence. To automatically firm all orders that must start during the current week, set the firming time fence to one week.

**Learn more:** [Firm planned orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/planned-order-firming)

An employee at a company releases a new product from the **Released product maintenance** workspace.  
  
An employee in a different department cannot add the product to a sales order. You determine that no dimension groups have been assigned to the product.  
  
You need to make sure that the product can be added to the sales order.  
  
Which two inventory dimension groups should be added to the product? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Released products require storage and tracking dimension groups for inventory transactions. The storage dimension group determines inventory storage dimensions, such as site and warehouse, and the tracking dimension group determines tracking dimensions; it can be configured with no active tracking dimensions when batch or serial tracking is unnecessary. Product dimension groups define product variants, while coverage groups are used for master-planning coverage settings.

**Learn more:** [Create a released product for a single company - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/create-released-product-single-company) · [Complete basic setup of a released product master - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/ga-ie/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/complete-basic-setup-released-product-master)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying the Warehouse Management mobile app in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company requires workers to scan item barcodes by using the mobile device scanner.  
  
You need to define the standard barcode format for GTIN.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Load default GS1 options for batch number.
Set up a custom bar code data policy.
Load standard bar code data policies.
Set up a custom application identifier.

questions.explanation:
GTIN uses GS1 application identifier 01, with a standard fixed-length numeric definition. Loading the default GS1 application identifiers imports the common international identifiers, including the GTIN definition. Barcode data policies control mappings of parsed barcode values to mobile-app fields and do not define the GTIN format.

**Learn more:** [GS1 bar codes and QR codes - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/gs1-barcodes)

You need to address the risk issue discovered during the internal audit.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
The Inventory value report storage report retains generated inventory valuation results in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, providing system-managed, reviewable report data instead of editable spreadsheet-based reports. The standard Inventory value report does not save its results, while costing versions control standard-cost calculations rather than inventory-value report retention.\

You need to address the issue identified by the inventory planner.  
  
What should you do next to resolve the issue?

options.text: Create a PO from the sales order.

questions.explanation:
Master planning uses the updated on-hand inventory and applicable demand and coverage settings to calculate net requirements and generate planned replenishment orders when needed. This lets the inventory planner determine whether the olive oil destroyed because of shelf life requires a new purchase order.\
\
**Learn more:** [Master planning home page - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/master-planning-home-page) · [Net requirements and pegging information - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/planning-optimization/net-requirements)

questions.question:
You must configure a new item that includes a vintage.  
  
What should you configure for the vintage?
questions.explanation:
A vintage is a production-year lot of the same wine item. Configure it as a batch so inventory can be identified and tracked by vintage, including financially tracked batch-level costs when required.\
\
**Learn more:** [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq) · [Track running average cost per inventory dimension](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/track-running-average-cost-per-inventory-dimension)

questions.question:
You need to set up cheese smart numbering to satisfy the requirement.  
  
Which component should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Filter codes, used with vendor product filters, can restrict the released items that are available for a particular vendor when purchase order lines are created. They provide a standard way to ensure that cheese items associated with a country or region are ordered only from the appropriate vendors. [Configure product filters for warehouse transactions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/filters-and-filter-codes)\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure product filters for warehouse transactions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/filters-and-filter-codes)

You are the logistics manager for a distribution company.  
  
Your primary carrier service supplies transportation rates between New York City and Colorado. The rates are flat rates determined by the pickup city or general area, as follows:  
  
- New York City = $500  
- Colorado = $450  
  
You need to configure Transportation Management to calculate the rate from New York City to Colorado.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use a Point-to-Point engine based on weight and miles. Assign rates from New York City as the starting location and Colorado as the ending location and break the rates out based on the weight of the package.
Using the Point-to-Point engine with an empty break master, assign rates based on starting and ending locations.
Create a Shipping carrier and service. Create carrier accessorial charges to represent the rates for each location.
Set up A Transit Time Engine to track days from New York City to Colorado. Set up rates in the Rate Master tied to day breaks.

questions.explanation:
A Point-to-Point rate engine with an empty break master is appropriate for flat transportation rates that depend only on the origin and destination. Break masters are used for tiered pricing factors such as distance or weight, so no break structure is needed when the location pair alone determines the rate. Microsoft Learn describes rate bases as supporting factors such as mileage or weight when a pricing structure requires breakpoints.

**Learn more:** [Set up rate masters, rate bases, and break masters - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/transportation/tasks/set-up-rate-masters)

questions.question:
Solution: In the rebate agreement, set the start date to the first day of the month. Set the expiry date to 30 days.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A vendor rebate that depends on total purchase quantity for a monthly period must use a monthly cumulative purchase calculation. The agreement dates control its validity period, but they do not by themselves aggregate purchase-order quantities for the month and apply the appropriate quantity tier.\
\
**Learn more:** [Vendor rebates - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/vendor-rebates)

questions.question:
Solution: On the rebate agreement, specify every item group assigned to wine. Add one quantity rebate line break for 10–100 and another rebate line break for 101–200.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Vendor rebate agreements that use an item group are processed individually for each qualifying item, not cumulatively across all items in that group. Consequently, bottle quantities from different wine varieties would not be combined to determine the 10–100 and 101–200 rebate tiers, so this setup cannot ensure the vendor’s rebate is claimed correctly for all wine purchases.\
\
**Learn more:** [Vendor rebates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/vendor-rebates)

questions.question:
Solution: Set the **Calculation date type** field on the rebate agreement to **Created**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
For a rebate tied to purchase orders placed during a month, the purchase order creation date must determine whether an order falls within the agreement’s validity period. The **Created** calculation date type uses that creation date.\
\
**Learn more:** [Vendor rebates - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/vendor-rebates)

questions.question:
Solution: On the rebate agreement, select **exact match** in the unit of measure rebate option.  
  
Does the solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
The **Exact match** unit-of-measure rebate option qualifies a purchase line only when its unit of measure is the same as the one specified on the rebate agreement. Because qualifying wine can be purchased by either bottle or case, this setting would exclude purchases made in the nonmatching unit; unit conversion is required to ensure both qualify. [Vendor rebates — Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/vendor-rebates)\
\
**Learn more:** [Vendor rebates — Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/vendor-rebates)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Three assets at one location each require the same tune-up. One worker can perform all three tune-ups, and the worker’s hours must be allocated to each asset.  
  
You need to configure the system for the worker.  
  
Which configuration should you use?

options.text: Create a consumption registration for the items.
Configure a job card for the device.

questions.explanation:
Separate work orders establish distinct maintenance records for the three assets, allowing the worker’s labor to be registered and attributed to each asset individually. Consumption registration supports posting hours, items, and expenses after work is performed, whereas labor standards define expected work and do not allocate actual hours.

**Learn more:** [Assets and work orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/objects-and-work-orders) · [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has implemented the Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management procurement module.  
  
During testing, you find that no transactions post to the product receipt journal when an item is received.  
  
You need to configure the system so that the appropriate transactions appear in the product receipt journal.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: On the Item group setup form, enter account information in the Purchase, accrual and Purchase expenditure, un-invoiced account fields.
On the Item model group setup form, select Include physical value.
On the Item group setup form, enter account information in the Purchase, accrual and Purchase expenditure for product fields.
On the Item model group setup form, select Accrue liability on product receipt.

questions.explanation:
Product-receipt ledger posting requires the item model group to accrue the liability at product receipt and the inventory posting profile to contain the Purchase, accrual and Purchase expenditure, un-invoiced accounts. The accrual setting creates the receipt liability posting, while the configured accounts supply the required ledger destinations for the receipt transaction.

**Learn more:** [Purchase order posting - Finance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/general-ledger/purchase-order-posting) · [Inventory costing FAQ - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/cost-management/inventory-costing-faq)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A Canadian company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
The company procures a single item from two European vendors. The purchase price agreements differ for each vendor. Shipping costs can vary for every order and involve multiple shipment legs over water and land.  
  
You need to calculate the landed cost of the item for each order to identify the most economical vendor.  
  
What should be configured?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Landed Cost, a journey template defines the multi-leg route that goods travel between ports during a voyage. It supports movement through water and land legs and enables the related landed-cost processing needed to calculate per-order import and shipping costs.

**Learn more:** [Multi-leg journey setup - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/multi-leg-journey-setup) · [Landed cost vs. Transportation management - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/landed-cost/landed-cost-vs-tms)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company that has two legal entities uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. You are creating new products and discover that CompanyA intends to use Warehouse management (WMS), whereas CompanyB does not.  
  
Each storage, tracking, and production dimension name and configuration must be the same in both companies.  
  
You must configure the dimensions that affect WMS for the new products.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer provides part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign a tracking group to the product and release it to both companies, changing one tracking group after release.
Leave storage group blank on the product and assign after release to both companies.
Assign storage group to the product and release to both companies, changing one after release.
Create a product master and assign configuration technology.

questions.explanation:
Products used with Warehouse management processes must be associated with a storage dimension group for which **Use warehouse management processes** is enabled. Storage and tracking dimension groups can be assigned to the released product in each legal entity, so leaving the shared product’s storage group blank allows CompanyA and CompanyB to receive the appropriate local assignments. A product master and its configuration technology define the shared product-dimension and variant model, keeping that model consistent across legal entities.

**Learn more:** [Create a product master](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/tasks/create-product-master) · [Warehouse management only mode with external shared warehouses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/warehousing/wms-only-mode-external-shared-warehouse)

A company sells jars of sliced or whole pickles in a range of jar sizes.  
  
You must set up the item so that pickles use one item number across all container sizes.  
  
Which two approaches can achieve this objective? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Setup the size, color, and style in each legal entity. Go to the products form, create a new product and assign it to each dimension.
Create a new product master with predefined variant configuration technology and release to the legal entities. Use the product dimensions to define the size, color, and style.
Create and release a product to the legal entities. Use the storage dimensions to define the size, color, and style.
Create a new product master with dimension-based configuration technology and release to the legal entities. Use the configuration to define the size, color, and style.

questions.explanation:
A product master supports multiple product variants under one master product number. Predefined variants can be defined by the Size, Color, and Style product dimensions. Dimension-based configuration uses the Configuration product dimension to identify variants, so configuration values can define the applicable size, color, and style combinations. Storage dimensions are not product-variant dimensions.

**Learn more:** [Product dimensions - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-dimensions) · [Dimension-based product configuration overview - Supply Chain Management | Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/dimension-based-product-configuration)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Three assets at one location require the same tune-up. One worker can perform all three tune-ups, and the worker’s hours must be allocated to each asset.  
  
You need to configure the system for the worker.  
  
Which configuration should be used?

options.text: Create a consumption registration for the expenses.
Create a consumption registration for the items.

questions.explanation:
A work order can be associated with multiple assets through separate work order maintenance jobs. When one worker performs those jobs, the Split hours function distributes a single hour-registration line evenly across the work order’s maintenance jobs, allocating the worker’s time to each asset. This function operates within one work order, so the tune-ups should be configured as separate jobs in that work order rather than as three separate work orders.

**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption) · [Assets and work orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/objects-and-work-orders)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management.  
  
Three assets at one location each require the same tune-up. One worker can perform all three tune-ups, and the worker’s hours must be allocated to each asset.  
  
You need to configure the system for the worker.  
  
Which configuration should you use?

options.text: Configure the operations resource and set it to human resource.
Create a consumption registration for the expenses.
Create one work order and split hours by work order job.

questions.explanation:
A work order can contain multiple work order jobs, with each job defined for an asset. The Split hours functionality distributes a single worker’s hour registration across the work order jobs, allocating the time to all three assets.

**Learn more:** [Register consumption - Supply Chain Management | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/consumption/register-consumption) · [Assets and work orders - Supply Chain Management | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/asset-management/overview/objects-and-work-orders)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. The company does not use variants and sells items from only one legal entity.  
  
You need to configure the system to prevent unnecessary product-creation overhead. What should you do?

options.text: Create a personal template for unreleased products
Create an unreleased product and release the product
Create a shared template for unreleased products

questions.explanation:
A released product is the appropriate distinct-product type when no variants are required. Creating it from the Released products page creates the product and automatically releases it to the current legal entity in a single operation, avoiding the additional overhead of creating an unreleased product and releasing it separately. A product master is used to define and generate product variants.

**Learn more:** [Product information overview - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-information) · [Unified product experience - Finance & Operations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/data-entities/dual-write/product-mapping)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to test the brakes that already exist in inventory.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign a Phantom bill of materials (BOM) line.
Create a manual quality order for existing inventory.
Assign brakes to an inventory status that is blocked.
Create an automatic quality order for existing inventory.

questions.explanation:
Quality orders are used to define and record inventory inspections and test results. They can be created manually for on-hand inventory, and the certification scenario treats automatic quality-order creation as an alternative quality-management process. An inventory status of blocked only restricts inventory availability, while a phantom BOM line does not create a quality inspection process.

**Learn more:** [Quality orders - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-orders) · [Quality associations - Supply Chain Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/inventory/quality-associations)
